headings.text: Shaul leh Yahnathan tunga David’ Kah la

verses.text: Shaul a sih khit ciangin, Amalek mite a zawhna panin David ciah a, Ziklag ah ni nih a om hi.
A ni thum ni-in Shaul’ giahphual panin mi khat a puan kikeksa leh a lu tungah leivui a baangin hong tung hi. David kiangah a tun ciangin, leilak ah puksukin a kun hi.
David in ama kiangah, “Koi pan hong pai na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Israyl-te giahphual panin a suakta ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.

Tua ciangin David in ama kiangah, “Bang thu piang ahi hiam? Hong gen in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Gal sung panin mite taimang uh hi. Amaute tampitak pukin si uh a, Shaul leh a tapa Yahnathan zong si uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
David in ama kiangah thu a puak tangvalpa kiangah, “Shaul leh Yahnathan a sih lam bang ci theih na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Tangvalpa in, “Gilboa Mual ah ka om kha a, tua lai-ah Shaul a teipi tungah kingam a, Sakol leengte leh a tung tuangte inlah pha neh mahmah ta uh hi.
Amah kihei-in kei hong muh ciangin, kei hong sama, tua ciangin keimah in, ‘Hiah om ing ei,’ ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, ‘Nang kua na hi hiam?’ ci-in hong dong hi. Tua ahih ciangin keimah in, ‘Amalek mi khat ka hi hi,’ ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in kei kiangah, ‘Ka tungah ding inla, kei hong that in! A si ding ka hi ta a, ahih hangin ka naang lai hi,’ hong ci hi.

Tua ahih manin ama tungah dingin ka that hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a tuk khit ciangin nungta zo nawn lo ding cih ka thei hi. Tua ciangin ama lu tunga kumpi-lukhu leh a bana banbulh ka la-a, tuate hih lai-ah ka ukpa kiangah kong paipih hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David leh amah tawh a om mi khempeuh in a puan uh manin a balkek uh hi.
Amaute nitak dong Shaul, a tapa Yahnathan leh Yahweh’ mite hangin thuumin kapin an tang uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh namsau tawh amaute si uh hi.
David in thu a puak tangvalpa kiangah, “Koi pan na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Kei pen Amalek mi peemta khat ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin David in ama kiangah, “Yahweh’ sathau nilhsa mipa susia dingin bang hangin na khut liik ding kihta lo na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Tua khit ciangin David in a tangvalte khat samin, “Pai inla that in!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in a satlum suk hi.
David in ama kiangah, “Nangma sisan nangma tungmah tu hi. Nangma kam mahmah tawh nang langah nangmah teci pangin, ‘Yahweh’ sathau nilhsa mipa ka that hi,’ na ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Shaul leh a tapa Yahnathan tungah David in hih kah la tawh tamlo-in,
amah in Yahdah mite tungah hih Thal Kah la a kihilh nadingin thu a pia hi. (Hih pen Yasher Laibu sungah kigelh hi.)
“Israyl-te aw, na minthanna, na mual sangte tungah kithat! A vangliatpa bangci puk a hia!
Gath ah gen kei inla, Ashkelon kongzingte ah tangko kei in, tua bang hi keileh Philistia-te’ tanute nuamlua ding uh a, vun-at loh-te’ tanute lungdam kha ding uh hi.

Gilboa mualte aw, no tungah daitui ahi a, guahtui ahi zongin ngah kei unla, lote in zong biakna-a dingin an gah kei tahen. Bang hang hiam cihleh tua lai-ah vanglianpa’ kidalna lum kininsak a, Shaul’ kidalna lum lah sathau a kizut nawn lo hi.
A kithatte’ sisan pan leh a vangliante’ satak panin, Yahnathan’ thal guakkik ngei lo a, Shaul’ namsau zong hong guakkik ngei lo hi.
Shaul leh Yahnathan a hin lai-un ki-itin ngaihhuai uh a, a sih hunun a kikhen kei uh hi. Amaute, muvanlaite sangin manlangzaw uh a, humpinelkaite sangin thahatzaw uh hi.
Israyl’ tanute aw, note puan san hong silhsakin nuamtakin hong omsakpa, na puansilhte uh kham tawh hong zepsakpa Shaul aa dingin kap un.
A vanglianpa bang hangin gal sungah tuk mawk ahi hiam! Na mual sangte tungah Yahnathan kithatin om hi.
Ka sanggampa Yahnathan aw, nang hangin ka dah hi; kei nong it lua hi. Kei tunga nong itna lamdangin, numei’ itna sangin lianzaw hi.
A vanglianpa bang hangin tuk mawk hiam! Galsimna galvante sia khin tah maw!” a ci hi.

Hih thu khit ciangin David in Yahweh thu dongin, “Yahdah khuapite khatpeuh ah ka pai ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Paito in,” a ci hi. David in, “Koi ah pai ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Hebron ah,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ahih manin David leh a zite nih ahi Yezreel mi Ahinoam leh Nabal’ zi meigong Abigail-te tawh tua lai a pai uh hi.
David in amah tawh a om mite zong samin, amau innkuanpih ciat tawh Hebron leh a khuapite sungah amaute a teng uh hi.

Tua ciangin tua lai-ah Yahdah mite pai-in, Yahdah innkuan tungah kumpi-in David sathau a nilh uh hi. Amaute in David kiangah hih thu zong gen uh a, “Shaul a vuite pen Yabesh Gilead mite ahi hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin David in Yabesh Gilead mite kiangah kamtaite sawlin, amaute kiangah, “Note in na ukpa uh Shaul tungah hih bangin dikna lakin amah vui na hih manin Yahweh in thupha hong pia tahen.
Tua ahih ciangin hih na sepna uh hangin tu-in Yahweh in note tungah dikna leh cihtakna hong lak henla, keimah in zong note tungah tua mah bangin kong pahtawi ding hi.
Tu-in na ukpa uh Shaul si khinin, Yahdah innkuante in amaute tungah kumpi-in kei sathau hong nilh khin ahih manin thahat unla, hang un,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Shaul’ galkap mangpa Ner’ tapa Abner in Shaul’ tapa Ishbosheth la-in, Mahanaim ah paipih hi.
Amah in Gilead-te tung, Asher mite tung, Yezreel-te tung, Ephraim-te tung, Benyamin-te tung leh Israyl khempeuh tungah kumpi-in a koih hi.
Shaul’ tapa Ishbosheth in Israyl uk ding a kipat lai-in amah kum 40 pha ta a, amah in kum nih sung uk hi. Yahdah innkuan bek in David zui uh hi.
Yahdah innkuan tung Hebron ah David in kumpi a sep sungteng pen kum sagih leh kha guk ahi hi.
Shaul’ tapa Ishbosheth’ mite tawh Ner’ tapa Abner in Mahanaim nusia-in Gibeon ah a pai uh hi.
Zeruyah’ tapa Yahab leh David’ mite paikhia-in, Gibeon bual ah a va dawntuah uh hi. A khatte bual langkhat ah, adang a khatte adang bual langkhat ah omin amaute a tu uh hi.
Tua ciangin Abner in Yahab kiangah, “Tangvalte dingsakin, eite mai-ah kidemsak ni,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahab in, “Kidem uh hen,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute dingto a—Benyamin leh Shaul’ tapa Ishbosheth-te aa dingin mi sawm le nih leh David aa dingin mi sawm le nih a sehkhia uh hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in alang ciat uh lutang pan manin, a namsau tawh alang pa’ pang dawt ciat uh a, amaute a nih tuakun a puk uh hi. Tua ahih manin Gibeon-a om tua mun pen Helkath Hazzurim; Namsaute phual, kici hi.
Tua ni-in kidona nasia takin om a, David’ mite mai panin Abner leh Israyl mite kizo hi.
Zeruyah’ tapa thumte: Yahab, Abishai, leh Asahel-te tua lai-ah a om uh hi. Tu-in amah pen gam sazukpi banga ngalhat ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Asahel in Abner delhin, veilam ahi a, taklam ahi zongin a pial loin a delh hi.
Tua ciangin Abner in amah leh-et a, “Nang na hia, Asahel?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Hi mah ing,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Abner in ama kiangah, “Taklam ahih keileh veilam ah pial in. Tangval khat va man inla, nang aa dingin a galhiam la in,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin Asahel khawl tuan loin amah a delh hi.

Tua ahih manin Abner in Asahel kiangah gen leuleu a, “Hong delh nawn ken! Bang hangin nang hong sattuk ding ka hi hiam? Hong vat leng kimai tuahin na sanggampa Yahab bangci et mawk ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Asahel in a delhna khawl nuam tuan lo hi; tua ciangin Abner in a teipi tong lamin Asahel gilpi sunin a teipi in a nunglam ah a pailet hi. Amah tua lai-ah pukin, a pukna ah a si hi. Asahel pukin a sihna mun ah a tung peuhpeuh a khawl uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahab leh Abishai in Abner delh uh a, ni a tum laitakin Gibeon Sehnel gam paina lampi-a om Giah nai-a Ammah mual ah amaute a tung uh hi.
Tua ciangin Benyamin mite Abner nungah a kikaikhawm uh hi. Amaute honkhat kisuahin mualtung khat ah a pang uh hi.

Tua ciangin Abner in Yahab samin, “Namsau tawh kithat den ding ahi hiam? A kha mahmahin tawp ding lam phawkkha lo na hi hiam? A sanggamte a delh uh a khawl nadingun thu na piak ding bang tanvei sawt lai ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Yahab in, “Yahweh a nungta ahih mah bangin, tu zingsangin hong ci hi lecin, mite in a sanggamte delh lo ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahab in peengkul muut a, tua ciangin mi khempeuh khawlin, Israyl-te delh nawn loin, zong a do nawn kei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Abner leh a mite Arabah kantanin tua zan tawntung a pai uh hi. Amaute in Yardan kantan uh a, Bithronbuppi kantan suakin Mahanaim a tung uh hi.
Abner nungdelhna panin Yahab ciahkikin, a mite a kaikhawm hi. David’ mi sawm le kua leh Asahel a kisam hi.
Ahih hangin David’ mite in Abner tawh a pang khawm Benyamin mi 360 a that uh hi.
Amaute in Asahel la-in Bethlehem-a a pa’ han ah a vui uh hi. Tua ciangin Yahab leh a mite zan tawntung pai uh a, khuavak tuungin Hebron a tung uh hi.
Shaul innkuan leh David innkuan kikalah sauveipi galkidona a om hi. David thahat semsemin, Shaul’ innkuan thanem semsem hi.
Hebron ah David’ tapate a suak hi. A tacil pen Yezreel mi Ahinoam tawh a neih Ammon hi a,
A nihna pen Carmel mi Nabal’ zi meigong Abigail tawh a neih Chileab ahi hi; a thumna pen Geshur-a Talmai kumpipa’ tanu Maacah tawh a neih a tapa Absalom ahi hi;
A lina pen Haggith’ tapa Adoniyah hi a, a ngana pen Abital’ tapa Shephatyah ahi hi;
A gukna pen David’ zi Eglah tawh a neih Ithream ahi hi. Hihte pen Hebron ah David sung pan a suak ahi hi.
Shaul innkuan leh David innkuan kikalah galkidona leh kivatna a om laitakin, Abner ama mun ah thahatin Shaul innkuan sungah vanglian hi.
Shaul in zineu khat nei a, a min pen Rizpah hi a, Aiah’ tanu ahi hi; tuanu’ thu Ishbosheth in Abner kiangah dongin, “Bang hangin ka pa’ zineu tawh lum khawm na hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Ishbosheth thu genna hangin Abner heh mahmah a, amah in, “Yahdah-te neihsa ui lutang ka hi kei hi! Tuni-in David vangliatna ah note kong piak lohna tawh na pa Shaul innkuan tung, na sanggamte tung, leh na lawmte tungah ka ci tak hi; tua hi napi-in hih numei tawh kisai-in tuni-in kei nong mawhsak hi.
Yahweh in David tungah kiciamna tawh kamciam a piak bang teekteekin David aa dingin ka hihsak kei tak leh Yahweh in Abner tungah a ututin hong bawl henla tua sang a nasiazawin zong hong behlap tahen.
A thuciamna ah: Shaul’ innkuan panin kumpigam a suan khiat nading leh Dan panin Beersheba ciang dong Israyl tung leh Yahdah tungah David’ kumpi tokhom Ka kipsak ding hi, ci hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Ishbosheth in amah kihta ahih manin ama tungah a gen beh ngam nawn kei hi.

Tua ciangin Abner in David kiangah ama tangin kamtaite sawlin, “Hih kua gam hiam? Kei tawh thukimna hong bawl in, Israyl khempeuh nang kiangah a paipih dingin nang nungah ka vangliatna ka koih ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin David in dawngin, “Hoih hi, nang tawh thukimna kong bawl ding hi, ahih hangin kong nget thu khat om hi. Kei tawh kimu dingin nong pai ciangin Shaul’ tanu Michal nong tonpih kei leh, ka mai na mukha kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Shaul’ tapa Ishbosheth kiangah kamtaite sawlin, “Keimah in Philistia-te vundawn zakhat tawh ka leisa ka zi Michal hong pia in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Ishbosheth in thupia-in, Laish’ tapa a pasal Paltiel kiang panin a lakhiasak hi.
A pasal in amah zui-in Bahurim paina lam tawntung a zi nungah a kapkap hi. Tua ciangin Abner in amah thupia-in, “Inn ah ciah in!” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah a ciahkik hi.
Israyl upate tawh Abner kikumin, “A beisa hunin note tunga kumpi dingin David na deih uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, hisak un! Yahweh in David’ thu genzo a, ‘Ka nasempa David’ khut tawh Philistia-te vangliatna leh a galte khempeuh vangliatna panin ka mite ka hon ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.

Abner in Benyamin mite tungah a tuam vilvelin thu gen hi. Tua khit ciangin Israyl leh Benyamin innkuan buppi in a na khempeuh tua banga hih ding a utna uh David kiangah a gen dingin Hebron ah amah a pai hi.
Hebron-a David kiangah a mi sawm nih tawh Abner a tun ciangin Abner leh amah tawh a pai mite aa dingin David in pawi khat a kham hi.

Tua ciangin Abner in David kiangah, “Ka uk kumpipa aa dingin Israyl khempeuh a kaikhawm dingin ka paipah ding hong phal in, tua hileh amaute in nang tawh thuciamna khat bawl thei ding uh a, tua ciangin nangmah in na lungsim deihna bangin na uk thei pah ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin David in Abner sawlkhia a, amah lungnuamin a kuankhia hi.

Tua khit phetin a galsimna panun vanmat tampi pua-in David’ mite leh Yahab hong ciah uh hi. Ahih hangin Hebron ah David tawh Abner om nawn lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh David in amah sawlkhia khin a, amah lungnuamin a paikhin hi.
Yahab leh amah tawh a kuan mihon khempeuh a tun uh ciangin, amaute in Yahab kiangah, “Kumpipa kiangah Ner’ tapa Abner hong pai a, kumpipa in amah sawlkhia a, amah lungnuam takin a pai hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin kumpipa kiangah Yahab pai-in, “A bangci gamtat na hi hiam? En in, Abner nang kiangah hong pai hi. Bang hangin amah a paikhiat ding phal na hi hiam? Tu-in amah pai khin ta hi.
A taktakin Ner’ tapa Abner in nang hong khem ding, na gamtatnate hong encik ding leh na sep khempeuh a theih nop manin hong pai ahih lam na thei hi,” a ci hi.
David’ omna panin Yahab a paikhiat khit ciangin, amah in Abner’ kiangah kamtaite sawl a, amaute in Sirah Tuibeem panin amah hong paipihkik uh hi. Ahih hangin David in hih thu bangmah thei lo hi.

Hebron ah Abner hong tunkik ciangin, Yahab in amah tawh a kituam ho dingin kulh kongpi pam ah paikhiatpih hi. A sanggampa Asahel’ sisan phulakna-in tua lai-ah Yahab in Abner a gil sunin Abner a si hi.
Tua khit, David in hih thu a zak ciangin, amah in, “Ner’ tapa Abner’ sisan tawh kisai-in Yahweh mai-ah kei leh ka kumpigam a tawntungin ka mawhbaang lo hi.

Yahab lutung leh a pa’ innkuan khempeuh tungah Abner’ sisan tu tahen! Yahab’ inn sungah natna nei mi, phak nei mi, ciangkhut khun mi, namsau tawh a si mi, nek ding nei lo mi khatpeuh tawh kilawi ngei kei tahen!” a ci hi.
(Yahab leh a sanggampa Abishai in Abner that uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Gibeon-a galkidona ah a sanggampa uh Asahel a thahsak hi.)

Tua khit ciangin David in Yahab leh amah tawh a om mi khempeuh kiangah, “Na puante uh balkekin puanhampi silh unla, Abner mai-ah kapin pai un,” a ci hi. Kumpipa David mahmah zong a hankuang nungah a pai hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in Hebron ah Abner vui uh a, Abner’ han ah kumpipa a kapkhia beba hi. Mi khempeuh zong tua lai-ah a kap uh hi.
Abner hangin kumpipa in hih kah la sa hi: “thukhun palsatte sih bangin Abner si lawmlawm ding ahi hiam?
Na khutte kihen lo a, na khete kol kibulh lo hi. A gilo mite mai-a puk bang teekteekin na puk hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in amah a kah beh lai uh hi.

Tua ciangin amaute khempeuh pai uh a, sun kim laitakin David in khatpeuh a nek nadingin kun uh a, ahih hangin David kiciamin, “Ni a tumsuk matengin an ahi a, adang khatpeuh ahi zongin ka ciap leh, Yahweh in a ututin hong bawl henla, tua val zong hong behlap lai tahen,” a ci hi.
Mi khempeuh in thei uh a, a lungkim uh hi; a taktakin kumpipa hih peuhpeuh in mite khempeuh a lungkimsak hi.
Tua ni-in mi khempeuh leh Israyl khempeuh in Ner’ tapa Abner kithahna ah kumpipa a kihel loh lam a thei uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in a nasemte kiangah, “Tuni-in Israyl sungah ulian ahi mi lian khat a si ahih lam thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Tuni-in sathau kinilh kumpipa ka hih hangin ka tha nem hi; kei aa dingin hih Zeruyah’ tapate thuak haklua hi. A gamtatsiapa ama siat gamtatna tawh kizui-in Yahweh in thukkik tahen!” a ci hi.
Hebron ah Abner a sihkhitna thu Shaul’ tapa Ishbosheth in a zak ciangin, a lungkia-in, Israyl khempeuh a patau uh hi.

Shaul’ tapa in galkapte a makaih mi nih a nei hi. Khatpa’ min pen Baanah hi a, adang khatpa pen Rechab ahi hi; amaute pen Benyamin minam pana Beeroth mi Rimmon’ tapate ahi uh hi. (Beeroth pen Benyamin khenkhatin zong kisim hi,
bang hang hiam cihleh Gittaim ah Beeroth mite tai uh a, tua lai-ah tuni dong teng uh hi.)

(Shaul’ tapa Yahnathan in a khe langnihin a zaw tapa khat nei hi. Yezreel panin Shaul leh Yahnathan’ thu a kizakin amah kum nga a pha hi. Amah a cingnu in la-in taipih a, a tai dingin nawhtat lua-in naupang kia a, tua hangin a khete a zaw ahi hi. Ama min pen Mephibosheth ahi hi.)
Tua ciangin Beeroth mi Rimmon’ tapate Rechab leh Baanah kipankhia-in Ishbosheth’ inn ah sun khualum hunin tua lai-ah tung uh a, Ishbosheth a lupna tungah sun tawlnga-in a lum hi.
Amaute in mangbuh la ding kineihin inn sungtawng ah lut uh a, innkong cingpa a gilpi dawt uh hi. Tua khit ciangin Rechab leh a sanggampa Baanah a taikhia uh hi.
A lupna inndei sungah Ishbosheth a lup laitakin inn sungah amaute a lut uh hi. Amaute in dawtin a thah khit uh ciangin, a lu tankhia-in pua uh a, Arabah lam tawnin zan tawntungin a pai uh hi.

Amaute in Hebron-a David kiangah Ishbosheth’ lutang puak uh a, kumpipa kiangah, “Na nuntakna hong laksak sawm na galpa Shaul’ tapa Ishbosheth’ lutang hiah om hi. Yahweh in Shaul leh ama suanlekhakte tungah ka uk kumpipa’ phu a la khin hi,” a ci hi.
David in Beeroth mi Rimmon’ tapate ahi Rechab leh a sanggampa Baanah dawngkikin, amaute kiangah, “Haksatna khempeuh panin ka nuntakna hong hukhia Yahweh a nungta taktak ahih mah bangin,
mi khat in, “Shaul si ta hi,” ci-in hong genin thu hoih taktak a puakin amah kingaihsun a, ahih hangin keimah in amah manin Ziklag ah ka that hi. Tua pen ama thupuakna hangin a saan thaman ahi hi.
Migilote in thumaan mi khat a inn sunga a lupna tungah a thah ciangin note’ khut panin ama sisan hong siikin leitung panin hong beimangsakzaw tham lo ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi.

Tua ciangin David in a tangvalte sawlin, amaute in tuate a that uh hi. A khutte leh a khete uh satkhiatsakin, Hebron-a bual kiangah amaute a khai uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in Ishbosheth’ lutang la-in Hebron-a Abner’ han ah a vui uh hi.
Hebron-a David kiangah Israyl minam khempeuh hong pai-in, “A taktakin kote na guh leh na satak ka hi uh hi.

A beisa hunte ah zong kote tungah Shaul kumpi ahih lai-in Israyl’ galsimna ah a makai nangmah na hi a, amaute kuankhiatpihin nong ciahpihkik hi. Yahweh in nang kiangah, ‘Nangmah in ka mite tuu bangin na cing ding a, amaute tungah ukpa na hi ding hi,’ hong cizo hi,” a ci uh hi.

Hebron-a kumpipa kiangah Israyl upate khempeuh a tun uh ciangin, Kumpi David in Yahweh mai Hebron ah amaute tawh thuciamna khat bawl a, amaute in Israyl khempeuh tungah kumpi-in David sathau a nilh hi.
David in uk dingin a kipatin amah kum 30 pha a, amah in kum 40 sung a uk hi.
Amah in Hebron panin Yahdah kum sagih leh kha guk sung uk hi. Yerusalem panin amah in Israyl khempeuh leh Yahdah kum 33 sung uk hi.

Tua lai-a a teng Yebus mite a do dingin Yerusalem ah Kumpipa leh a mite kuan uh hi. Yebus mite in David kiangah, “Hih lai-ah nong lut zo kei ding hi; mittawte leh khebaite nangawn in nang hong notkhiazo ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Amaute in, “Hih lai-ah David hong lutzo lo ding hi,” ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.
Ahih hangin David in Zion mun muanhuai a la hi. (Zion pen David Khuapi ahi hi.)

Tua ni-in David in, “Yebus-te a zo peuhmah in David’ galte ahi ‘Mittawte leh khebaite’ omna mun tun nadingun tuizawl dungah pai tahen. Tua thu hangin amaute in, “Mittawte leh khebaite, tua inn sungah lut thei lo ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Mun muanhuai sungah David teng a, tua pen David Khuapi a kici hi. Tua ciangin David in Millo leh a sunglam panin a kiimkot khempeuh ah a lam hi.
Vanglianpen Yahweh in amah ompih ahih manin amah vanglianin a hat semsem hi.
Tyre kumpipa Hiram in David kiangah kamtaite sawlin, taamtak singte, khutsiamte leh leisek siamte tonpihsak a, amaute in David aa dingin omna khat lamsak uh hi.
Yahweh in Israyl tungah kumpi-in amah a kipsak khitna leh Yahweh in Ama mi Israyl-te a khualna-in a kumpigam a tawisang na thu David a thei hi.
David in Hebron a nusiat khit ciangin amah in Yerusalem ah zite leh zineute lakthuah lai hi. David’ tapate leh tanute piangthuah lai hi.
Hihte pen Yerusalem ah a neih a tapate min ahi hi: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
Ibhar, Ylishua, Nepheg, Yaphia,
Ylishama, Ylyada, leh Yliphelet ahi hi.

Israyl khempeuh kumpi-in David sathau a kinilh khitna thu Philistia-te in a zak uh ciangin, Philistia-te khempeuh in amah a zong dingin a kuan to uh hi. David kiangah hih thu kipuak a, mun muanhuai ah amah paisuk hi.
Philistia-te zong kuansukin, Rephaim Kuam sungah a kiphalh uh hi;

Tua ahih manin David in Yahweh thu dongin, “Keimah pai-in Philistia-te ka sim ding hiam? Ka vangliatna sungah amaute nong pia ding hiam?” a ci hi. Yahweh in David kiangah, “Pai to in, nang tungah Philistia-te kong ap taktak ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.

Tua ahih manin Baal Peretzim ah David pai-in amah in tua lai-ah amaute a zo hi. David in, “Tui phutkhap bangin Yahweh in ka mai-a galte hong phutkhapsak hi,” a ci hi. Hih thu hangin amah in tua mun min pen Baal Peretzim; Topa kiphukham, ci-in min a phuah hi.
Philistia-te in tua lai-ah a pasiante’ limte uh (elohim, teraphim) taisan uh ahih manin David leh a mite in a puakhia uh hi.
Philistia-te kuanto leuleu-in, Rephaim Kuam sungah kiphalh uh a,
tua ahih manin David in Yahweh thu dongkik a, Amah in, “Tang takin na paito peuhmah kei ding a, amaute’ nunglam ah a kualin kiimkotin pai inla, lungli kungte mai panin amaute do in.
Lungli kungte’ dawn ah lampaina kheging na zak ciangin manlangin kuan in; bang hang hiam cihleh Philistia galkapte a vat dingin na mai-ah Yahweh kuan khin hi, a cihna ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in amah thu a piak bang teekteekin David gamta a, amah in Geba panin Gazer ciang dong Philistia-te a notkik hi.
David in Israyl mi a kitengkhia khempeuh kaikhawm leuleu a, a vekpi-in 30,000 (tul sawmthum) a pha hi.

Singkuang tunga tu-in Cherub-te kikal ah kumpi tokhom a luah, Vanglianpen Yahweh’ Min tawh a kisam Yahweh’ singkuang tua mun panin a paipih to dingin Yahdah-a Baale (Kiryat Yearim) panin David leh amah tawh a om a mite a pai uh hi.
Amaute in Yahweh’ singkuang leeng thak khat tungah koih uh a, mual tunga om Abinadab’ inn panin a paikhiatpih uh hi. Abinadab’ tapate ahi Uzzah leh Ahio in leeng thak makaih uh a,
amaute in mual tunga om Abinadab’ inn panin Yahweh’ singkuang tawh tua leeng paipihin, Ahio a mai-ah a pai hi.
David leh Israyl innkuan khempeuh in taksing pana kibawl tum theih nam khempeuh: harp-te, khausai tumgingte, khuangneute, khuangtuahte, leh daltuahte tawh Yahweh mai-ah pawi bawl uh hi.
Nachon neih ancilna phual ah amaute a tun uh ciangin bawngtal-te muktu ahih manin Uzzah in a khut zanin Yahweh’ singkuang a len hi.
Uzzah in a zahtakbawl lohna hangin ama tungah Yahweh’ hehna kuang a, Yahweh in amah sattukin, Yahweh’ singkuang kiangah a si hi.
Tua ciangin Uzzah tungah Yahweh’ puakkhap vatna hangin David a hehsuak hi; tua ahih manin amah in tua mun min pen Peretz Uzzah; Uzzah tungah puakkhapna, ci a, tuni dong kici hi.
Tua ni-in David in Yahweh kihta a, amah in, “Yahweh’ singkuang bangci bangin ka kiang hong tung thei ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in amah tawh a om dingin David Khuapi sungah Yahweh’ singkuang a la kei hi. Tua tangin Gitt mi Obed-Edom inn ah a tuam koih hi.
Gitt mi Obed-Edom’ inn ah Yahweh’ singkuang kha thum sung om a, Yahweh in Obed-Edom leh a innkuanpihte khempeuh thupha a pia hi.

Tua ciangin hih thu Kumpi David kiangah kipuakin, “Yahweh’ singkuang hangin Yahweh in Obed-Edom leh a neih na khempeuh thupha a pia hi,” ci-in kigen hi. Tua ahih manin David paisukin, Obed-Edom inn panin David Khuapi ah lungnopna tawh Yahweh’ singkuang a paipihto hi.
Yahweh’ singkuang a puate in kal guk a suan uh ciangin bawngtal khat leh bawngno vakthau khat tawh amah in biakpiakna a pia hi.
Tua ciangin David in saihadial siampi puan khat silhin, a tha neih khempeuh tawh Yahweh mai-ah a laam hi.
David leh Israyl innkuan khempeuh in otnate leh peengkul awgingte tawh Yahweh’ singkuang a paipihto uh hi.
David Khuapi sungah Yahweh’ singkuang a lut laitakin Shaul’ tanu Michal in tawlet panin a na khuadak hi. Yahweh mai-ah Kumpi David laamin diangin a omna a muh ciangin a lungsim sungah a zahpih hi.
Amaute in Yahweh’ singkuang paipih uh a, David in a koihna dingin a lamsa puanbuk laizangah a koih hi. Tua khit ciangin David in Yahweh mai-ah meihal biaknate leh kilemna biaknate a pia hi.
David in meihal biaknate leh kilemna biaknate a piak khit ciangin, amah in Vanglianpen Yahweh’ Min tawh mite thupha a pia hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in Israyl mihon buppi lakah numei hitaleh pasal hitaleh mimal khat ciat tungah anlum khat, nisuh moh khat leh leenggahkeu pheeng khat ciat a pia hi. Tua khit ciangin mi khempeuh pai-in a inn ciat ah a ciah uh hi.

A innkuanpihte thupha pia dingin David a ciah ciangin Shaul’ tanu Michal in amah dawn dingin hong pai-in, “Tuni-in Israyl kumpipa a nasem numeite muhna ah kiseel buang sam loin mi neu khat’ gamtat bangin na gamtatna thu ngaisun thei kei tak cei,” a ci hi.

David in Michal kiangah, “Tua pen na pa ahih keileh ama innkuan khempeuh-a khatpeuh sangin kei hong teelzaw Yahweh mai-ah hi a, Amah in Yahweh’ mi Israyl-te tungah ukpa-in hong koih hi a, Yahweh mai-ah ka lungdam ding mah ahi hi.
Hih sangin zong ka pahtawi huai kei zaw lai ding a, keima mit mahmah ah ka kiniamkhiat ding hi; ahih hangin nangma gen nasem numeite in ahih leh, kei hong pahtawi lai ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Shaul’ tanu Michal a sih hun dong nangawnin a luppih ngei nawn kei hi.
Kumpipa ama inn sungah tengin Yahweh in ama kiima a galte khempeuh panin tawlngakna a piak khit ciangin,
David in kamsang Nathan kiangah, “Hih lai taamtak inn hoih sungah keimah ka om a, ahih hangin Yahweh’ singkuang pen puanbuk sungah a omlai hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Nathan in kumpipa kiangah, “Yahweh in nang hong ompih ahih manin pai inla, na lungsima om bangin sem in,” a ci hi.
Tua zanin Nathan kiangah Yahweh’ kammal hong tungin:
“Pai inla, Ka nasempa David gen in: Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi, ‘Kei aa dingin inn khat a lam sawmpa na hi hiam?
Egypt panin Israyl mite ka paikhiatpih-a kipanin tuni mahmah dong inn sungah ka teng nai kei hi. Puanbuk sung hitaleh biakbuk sung hitaleh ah ka kikhin kawikawi hi.

Israyl mi khempeuh tawh ka paina peuhpeuh ah, tuu bangin ka mi Israyl-te a cing dingin thu ka piaksa amau gam-ukte khatpeuh tungah, ‘Bang hangin taamtak sing tawh kilam inn khat kei aa dingin hong lamsak lo na hi uh hiam?’ ci-in gen ngei ka hi hiam?’ ci hi.
Tua hi a, tu-in Ka nasem David tungah hih bangin na gen ding hi: Vanglianpen Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: ka mi Israyl-te a uk dingin na tuuhon zuihna panin leh lonona panin nang kong la hi.
Na painasa khempeuh ah nang kong ompih den a, na mai panin na galte khempeuh ka hawlkhia hi. Tu-in keimah in leitunga mi lianpente’ min bangin na min ka liansak ding hi.

Tua ciangin Ka mi Israyl-te aa dingin mun khat ka sehsak ding a, tenna inn a neih theih nading leh a kikhin nawn loh nadingun amaute ka suan ding hi. Gitlohna’ tapate in a kipat cilin a hih bangun amaute nengniam nawn lo ding uh a,

Ka mi Israyl-te tungah thukhen dingte ka seh huna kipan a hih bangun amaute nengniam nawn lo ding uh hi; na galte khempeuh kiang panin tawlngakna zong kong pia ding hi. Amah in nang aa dingin inn khat kipsak ding hi, ci-in Yahweh in nang zong hong gen hi.
Na nuntakna bei-in na pu na pate tawh na ihmut ciangin, Keimah in nang hong laih dingin nangma pumpi mahmah panin hong piang na khaici ka laamto ding a, ama kumpigam ka kipsak ding hi.
Tuapa pen Keima Min aa ding Inn lam dingin a kipanpa hi a, ama kumpigam’ tokhom a tawntungin ka kipsak ding hi.
Kei pen ama Pa ka hi ding a, amah pen Ka tapa hi ding hi. Amah a khialh leh, mihingte’ ciangtawn leh mihingte satna khauhualte tawh ka puah ding hi.
Ahih hangin nangma mai panin ka hepkhiat ahi Shaul kiang panin ka itna ka lak khiat bangin ama kiang panin ka itna ka lakhia kei ding hi.
Ka mai panin na innkuan leh na kumpigam a tawntungin kip ding hi. Na kumpi-tokhom a tawntungin kip ding hi, ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.
Nathan in hih maangmuhna kammalte khempeuh David kiangah a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David lutin, Yahweh mai-ah tu a, amah in, “Pa Yahweh aw, kei kua ka hiam? Hih ciang dong nong tunpih dingin ka innkuanpihte bang ahi hiam?

Tua hi a, Pa Yahweh aw, nangma muhna ah hihte a kicing lo bang ahi phial zongin na nasempa innkuan vai mailam aa ding zong nong gen khin zo hi. Pa Yahweh aw, mihing khat tawh na kizopzia hih bang mah ahi hiam?
Tu-in David in nang tungah bang hong gen beh nawn ding ka hi hiam? Pa Yahweh aw, nangmah in na nasempa nong thei hi.
Na kammal hangin leh na deihna tawh kizui-in hih na lianpi na sem khinzo a, na nasempa tungah nong theisak zo hi.
Pa Yahweh aw, lian si cia maw! Nang tawh a kibang khat zong omlo a, pasian (el) om lo hi. Ka bil mahmah uh tawh ka zaksa mah bangun Nangmah bek na om hi.

Egypt pan, minamte kiang pan, leh a pasiante (elohim) uh kiang panin na hotkhiat na mite mai-ah Ama aa dingin min bawlin, Ama gam aa dingin a lian a kihtakhuai nalamdangte bawlin Ama mi dingin a honkhia dingin Yahweh a paina hih leitung minam khat ahi na mi Israyl-te tawh a kibang kua om ahi hiam?
A tawntunga na aituam dingin na mi Israyl-te na kipsak khin a, amaute Pa na suak khin hi, Yahweh aw.
Tua hi a, Pa Yahweh aw, tu-in na nasempa leh a innkuante tawh kisai-in na bawlsa kamciam a tawntungin hong lenkip den in.
Nangma Min a tawntungin kiliansak henla, mite in, “Vanglianpen Yahweh in Israyl-te Pa hi,” ci ta uh hen. Nangma mai-ah na nasem David’ innkuante kikipsak tahen.

Israyl-te Pa, Vanglianpen Yahweh aw, nangmah in na nasempa tungah hih thu nong pulaaka, “Nang aa ding inn khat kong lamsak ding hi,” na ci hi. Hih thute khempeuh hangin na nasempa in nang tungah hih thungetna a lungsim sungah a mu hi.
Pa Yahweh aw, nang pen Pa na hi a, na kammalte manin, na nasempa tungah hih a thumaan thuciamna nong ciamzo hi.

Nangma mai-ah a kizopsuak theih nadingin na nasempa’ innkuan thupha piak ding hong lungkim in; Pa Yahweh aw, nangmah in hong gen khin na hih manin na thupha tawh na nasempa innkuan thupha kipia tawntung tahen,” a ci hi.
Hih thu teng khit ciangin David in Philistia-te zo-in amaute nuaisiah hi. David in Philistia-te vangliatna panin Metheg Ammah la hi.

Tua khit ciangin David in Moab-te a zo hi. Amah in aana takin leilak ah Moab mite lumsakin, khauzang khat tawh a teh hi. A tehna khauzang tan nihna sima om peuhmah thatin, a tehna khauzang tan thumna sima om peuhmah a nungtasak hi. Tua ahih manin Moab mite pen David’ uknuai mite suak a, ama tungah siah a pia uh hi.
Euphrates Gun dungah ama ukna ngahkik nuamin hong kuan ciangin David in Rehob’ tapa ahi Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer zong a zo hi.
David in ama kiang panin leeng tung tuangte 1,700 leh khe galkap 20,000 a man hi. David in leengkai sakol a vekpi-in a zagui attat a, ahih hangin 100 hawilai hi.
Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer huh dingin Damascus-a Aram mite a kuan toh uh ciangin David in Aram mite 22,000 a that hi.

Tua khit ciangin David in Damascus-a Aram mite gam ah khuapi cingte koih a, Aram mite pen David’ uknuai mi suak uh a, ama kiangah siah a puak uh hi. David a paina peuh ah Yahweh in gualzawhna a pia hi.
David in Hadadezer’ uliante aa ahi kham kidalna lum la-in, Yerusalem ah a paipih hi.
Kumpi David in Hadadezer’ khuapite ahi Betah leh Berothai panin sumngo tampitak a la hi.
David in Hadadezer’ galkap buppi a zawhna thu Hamath kumpipa Toi in a zak ciangin,

Toi tawh a kido ngei Hadadezer tungah a gualzawhna hangin a lungdampih ding leh a hopih dingin amah in Kumpi David kiangah a tapa Hadoram a sawl hi. Hadoram in ngun, kham leh sumngo vanzatte a paipih hi.
Kumpi David in a zawhsa minamte khempeuh kiang pana ngun leh khamte mah bangin hihte vanzatte Yahweh tungah a ap hi; a zawhsa minamte pen:
Aram, Moab, Ammon mite, Philistia mite, leh Amalek-te ahi hi. Rehob’ tapa Zobah kumpi Hadadezer kiang panin a lak vante zong amah in a ap hi.
Ci Kuam-a Aram mi 18,000 thahna panin hong ciahkik khit ciangin David a minthang semsem hi.
Amah in Edom gam sung khempeuh ah khuapi cingte koih a, Edom mite khempeuh zong David’ uknuai mi a suak uh hi. David a paina peuh ah Yahweh in gualzawhna a pia hi.
Israyl khempeuh David in uk a, David in ama mi khempeuh aa dingin thutang tak leh thumaan takin sem hi.
Zeruyah’ tapa Yahab in galkapte uk hi; Ahilud’ tapa Yahshaphat pen thuciamteh ahi hi;
Ahitub’ tapa Zadok leh Abiathar’ tapa Ahimelech-te pen siampi hi uh a, Serayah pen lai-at ahi hi;
Yahyada’ tapa Benayah in Chereth-te leh Peleth-te uk hi; David’ tapate pen makaipite ahi uh hi.
David in, “Yahnathan hangin Shaul innkuan sungah migitna ka lah theih nadingin Shaul’ innkuan sungah a omlai khatpeuh a om hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Tu-in Shaul’ innkuan sung panin Ziba kici nasem pasal khat omlai a, David mai-ah a kilaak dingin a kisam hi. Kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Ziba na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Na nasempa ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “Yahweh’ hehpihna ama tungah ka lah theih nadingin Shaul’ innkuan-a a omlai khatpeuh a om hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Ziba in kumpipa dawngin, “A khe tegel a bai Yahnathan’ tapa khat omlai hi,” a ci hi.
Kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Amah koi ah om hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Ziba in kumpipa kiangah, “Lo Debar-a Ammiel’ tapa Machir’ inn ah om hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David in mi sawlin, Lo Debar-a Ammiel’ tapa Machir’ inn panin a la hi.

Shaul’ tapa Yahnathan, a tapa Mephibosheth pen David’ omna sungah a tun ciangin, amah mai kunin zahtakna a bawl hi. David in, “Mephibosheth aw!” a ci hi. Amah in, “Na nasempa ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.

David in ama kiangah, “Lau kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh na pa Yahnathan hangin nangma tungah migitna kong lak ding a, na pu Shaul’ neihsa leitang khempeuh nang tungah kong piakkik ding hi; tua ciangin ka sabuai ah an nong ne tawntung ding hi,” a ci hi.
Mephibosheth kunsukin, “Ui si khat a bang lel keimah nong phawk tham dingin na nasempa bang hi lel ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Shaul’ nasempa Ziba samin, ama kiangah, “Shaul’ neihsa khempeuh leh a inn na ukpa’ tupa tungah ka piakik khin hi.

Nang leh na tapate leh na nasemte in ama aa dingin lo na kho ding uh hi. Na ukpa’ tupa in nek ding a neih nadingin an a piangte paipih ding uh a, ahih hangin na ukpa’ tupa Mephibosheth in ka sabuai ah an ne den ding hi,” a ci hi. (Tu-in Ziba in tapa sawm le nga leh nasem sawmnih a nei hi.)

Tua ciangin Ziba in kumpipa kiangah, “Ka kumpipa in a nasempa nong thupiak khempeuh, na nasempa in ka sep ding ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Mephibosheth in kumpipa’ tapate khat bangin David’ sabuai ah an a ne hi.
Mephibosheth in a min Michayah kici tapa moi lai khat nei a, Ziba’ innkuanpih mi khempeuh pen Mephibosheth’ nasemte ahi hi.
Tua hi a, Mephibosheth in kumpipa’ sabuai ah an ne den ahih manin Yerusalem ah Mephibosheth teng hi. Amah pen a khe tegel bai hi.
Hih Ammon mite’ kumpipa a sih khit ciangin, a tapa Hanun in kumpi a luah to hi.

Tua ciangin David in, “A pa Nahash in kei tungah migitna hong lah mah bangin Nahash’ tapa Hanun tungah migitna ka lak ding hi,” ci-in ngaihsun hi. Tua ahih manin a pa nusiatna hangin amah hehnem dingin David in a kamtaite a sawl hi. Ammon mite’ gam ah David’ mite a tun uh ciangin,

Ammon makaipite in a kumpipa uh Hanun kiangah, “David in na pa a zahtakna-in nang hong hehnem dingin mi hong paisakin um na hi hiam? David in khuapi sung encian ding, thu kansim ding leh a lumlet dingin a sawl hi lo ahi hiam?
Hih thu hangin Hanun in David’ mite manin, a khamul uh alang metkhiatsakin, a puantualte uh a laizang a tawbo ciangah attansakin, amaute a sawl khia hi.

David kiangah hih thu a kikoh ciangin, amah in amaute a dawn dingin mi a sawl hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute nakpi takin maizumin zahla mahmah uh hi. Kumpipa in, “Na khamul uh a saukik dong Yericho ah om unla, tua khit ciangin hong ciah un,” a ci hi.

Ammon mite in David a lungsim natsak velvalna uh a theih ciangin, Ammon mite in Beth Rehob leh Zobah panin Aram khe galkap 20,000, Maacah kumpipa tawh mi 1,000 leh Tob-a mi 12,000 sum tha tawh cial uh hi.
David kiangah hih thu a kikoh ciangin, amah in Yahab leh galsiam galkap khempeuh a sawl hi.
Ammon-te kuan khia uh a, khuapi kongpi lutna ah galdo dingin a kigual uh hi; tua laitakin Zobah, Rehob, Tob mite leh Maacah-te gamlak ah amau pawl ciatin a om uh hi.
Yahab in a nung leh a mai-ah amah a sim dingin gal in a panna a muh ciangin, amah in Israyl galsiampen pawlkhat teelkhia-in, Aram mite a do dingin a pangsak hi.
A galtha a omlai teng a sanggampa Abishai’ thupiakna mang dingin koih a, Ammon mite a do dingin a pangsak hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahab in, “Kei aa dingin Aram mite a hat luat leh kei nong huh ding a, ahih hangin note aa dingin Ammon mite a hat luat leh, nang hong huh dingin kei kong pai ding hi.
Kihangsak inla, i mite aa ding leh i Pa’ khuapite aa dingin hangsan takin do ni. Yahweh in hoih a sak bangin hong sem tahen!” ci-in thu a pia hi.
Tua ahih manin Aram mite a sim dingin Yahab leh a mite mainawt uh a, ama mai-ah amaute a tai uh hi.

Ammon mite in Aram mite a taikekna a muh uh ciangin, Abishai kiang panin amaute zong tai uh a, khuapi sungah a lut uh hi. Tua ahih manin Ammon mite a dona panin Yahab ciahkikin, Yerusalem ah a tung hi.
Israyl-te mai panin amaute a kizawh dipdepna Aram mite in a muh uh ciangin, amaute kigawmphakik uh hi.
Hadadezar in Euphrates Gun gal panin Aram mite kuanpih hi; Helam ah amaute pai-in Hadadezer’ galkap mangpa Shobach in amaute a makaih hi.
David kiangah hih thu a kikoh ciangin, amah in Israyl khempeuh kaikhawm a, Yardan kantanin Helam ah a tung hi. Aram mite in David a do dingin a pang uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl-te mai panin Aram mite taimang uh hi; David in leeng tung tuang 700 leh sakol tung tuang 40,000 a that hi. Amah in a galkap mangpa Shobach zong sattukin, tua lai-ah a si hi.

Israyl-te in amaute a zawh gawpna thu Hadadezer’ khutnuai-a om bangin a na a sem kumpite khempeuh in a theih uh ciangin, amaute in Israyl tawh kilemna bawl uh a, amaute uknuai mi a suak uh hi. Ammon mite a huh lai ding uh Aram mite zong a lau ta uh hi.

Kumpite galdo dingin a kuan khiat hun tua kum phalbi sungin David in kumpipa’ nasemte leh Israyl galkap buppi tawh Yahab kuan khiasak hi. Amaute in Ammon mite susia uh a, Rabbah a umcih uh hi. Ahih hangin Yerusalem ah David a omlai hi.
Nitak khatin a lupna panin David tho-in kumpi’ inn a khum tungah lam a siau kawikawi hi. Inn khum panin amah in a kisil numei khat mu a, tua numeinu a hoih mahmah hi.
David in tua numei’ thu a kan dingin mi a sawl hi. Amaute in, “Hih nu pen Hit mi Uriyah’ zi Eliam’ tanu Bathsheba ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin David in mi sawlin tuanu a samsak hi. Ama kiangah tuanu hong pai-in, amah in tuanu luppih hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuanu a nitna panin a kihahsiang khin phet ahi hi; tua khit ciangin tuanu a inn ah a ciah hi.
Ahih hangin numei gai-in, David kiangah, “Nau ka paii hi,” ci-in a gensak hi.
Tua ciangin David in Yahab kiangah, “Hit mi Uriyah ka kiangah hong sawl in,” ci-in hih thu a sawl hi. Yahab in David kiangah Uriyah a puak hi.
Ama kiangah Uriyah a tun ciangin, David in Yahab bangci a, galkapte bangci uh a, galvaite bangci mavan hiam, ci-in a dong hi.
Tua khit ciangin David in Uriyah thupia-in, “Na inn ah ciah inla na khete sil in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin kumpipa’ omna panin Uriyah ciahin, kumpipa’ kiang pana letsong khat a nungah a kipuak hi.
Ahih hangin Uriyah a kumpipa’ nasemte khempeuh tawh kumpipa’ inn lutna ah lum uh a, ama inn ah ciah lo hi.
David kiangah, “Uriyah a inn ah ciah lo,” ci-in a kikoh ciangin, David in Uriyah kiangah, “A gamla pana hong pai hilo na hi hiam? Bang hangin na inn ah ciah lo na hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Uriyah in David kiangah, “Singkuang, Israyl-te, leh Yahdah-te puanbuk sungah om uh a, ka galkap mangpa Yahab leh ka galkap mangpa’ khutnuai-a mite gamlak ah giahphual sat uh hi. Tua hi-a an ne tui dawn ding leh ka zi tawh lum dingin ka inn ah ciah ding ka hi hiam? Nang a nungta na hih mah bangin keimah in tua bangin ka gamta kei ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.

Tua ciangin David in Uriyah kiangah, “Hih lai-ah ni khat ombeh lai in, tua khit a zingciangin na kong puakkik ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Yerusalem ah tua ni leh a zingciang dong Uriyah taam lai hi.
David in amah samin amah tawh ne khawm dawn khawmin zu a khamsak hi. Ahih hangin a nitak ciangin a ukpa’ nasemte tawh a lupna tungah lum dingin a pai hi; ahih hangin a inn ah a ciah tuan kei hi.
Zingsang ciangin David in Yahab kiangah laikhak khat gelhin, Uriyah a puasak hi.
David in a laikhak sungah: Kidona a nasiat penna gal mai-ah a madawkin Uriyah na koih in. Amah kisattukin a sih theih nadingin ama guak nungkinsan un,” ci-in a gelh hi.
Yahab in khuapi a umcih laitakin galte a thahatna pente omna hi, ci-a a theihna mun ah Uriyah in mun a lak nadingin a seh hi.
Yahab tawh kido dingin khuapi-a mite hong kuan khiat uh ciangin, David’ galkapte sunga mi pawl khat a kithat hi. Hit mi Uriyah zong a si hi.
Yahab in David kiangah gal kidona thu a cingin puak a,
kamtaipa kiangah, “Kumpipa kiangah gal kidona thu na gen khit ciangin,
kumpipa’ hehna hong khang vat kha ding a, tua ciangin amah in, “Na kido uh ciangin bang hangin khuapi neh lua na hi uh hiam? Kulh panin amaute in hong kap ding uh cih phawk lo na hi uh hiam?

Yerubbesheth (Yerubbaal-Gideon)’ tapa Abimelech kua thah hiam? Amah a sih nadingin Thebez-a kulh panin numei khat in angawina suang tungnung khiat hilo ahi hiam? Bang hangin tua zahin kulh neh na hi uh hiam?” ci-in hong dong kha thei ding hi. Amah in hih bangin hong cihleh, ama kiangah, “Na nasem Hit mipa Uriyah zong si hi,” na ci ding hi,” ci-in a hilh hi.
Kamtaipa pai-in tunga, Yahab in gen dingin a sawl khempeuh David kiang a gen hi.
Kamtaipa in David kiangah, “Mite in kote hong zothawhin gamlak ah kote a do dingin hong kuan khia uh hi. Tua ciangin kote in a kulh kongpi lutna ciang dong ka lehnotkik uh hi.
Tua ciangin thaltawite in kulh tung panin na nasemte hong kap uh a, kumpipa’ mite pawlkhat si-in, na nasem Hit mi Uriyah zong si hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin David in kamtaipa kiangah, “Yahab kiangah na gen ding hih bang ahi hi: Hih thu hangin nangmah kilungkhamsak kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh namsau in khat thatin adang khat zong a that hi. Khuapi lamah na gal kidona uh nencip unla, lawnthal un, ci-in amah hanthotna-in hih thu na gen in,” a ci hi.
Uriyah’ zi in a pasal a sihna thu a zak ciangin a pasal hangin a thuum hi.
A thuumna hun a bei khit ciangin David in mi sawlin, a inn ah tuanu lasak a, ama zi suakin tapa khat a nei hi. Ahih hangin David’ gamtatna hangin Yahweh a lungkim lo hi.
Yahweh in David kiangah Nathan sawl hi. Ama kiangah Nathan tungin a gen inah: “Khuapi khat sungah mi nih om a, khat pen hau-in khat pen zawng hi.
A haupa in tuuhonte leh bawnghonte tampi tak nei hi.

Ahih hangin a zawng mipa in a leisa tuunu no khat lobuang bangmah a nei kei hi. Tuapa in tuuno khawi-in amah leh a tate tawh khang khawm hi. Tua in tuapa’ an mah ne-in a hai ngiat panin dawn a, tuapa’ ang sungah a lum hi. Tua pen ama aa dingin tanu bang ahi hi.

Tu-in a hau mipa kiangah khualzin mi khat hong tung a, ahih hangin a hau mipa in ama tuuhon pan ahi a, a bawnghon pan ahi zongin ama kianga a tung mipa aa dingin gawh nuam lo a, a zawng mipa’ tuuno laksakin, ama kianga a tung mipa aa dingin a gawhsak hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua mipa tungah David nakpi takin heh a, amah in Nathan kiangah, “Yahweh a nungta ahih mah bangin hih bangin a gamta mipa sihsak dingin kilawm hi.
Amah hih bangin gamta a, amah in hehpihna nei lo ahih manin a tuuno a zah li-in loh ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Nathan in David kiangah, “Nang pen tua mipa na hi hi! Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh in hih bangin gen hi: Israyl-te kumpi-in nangmah sathau kong nilh a, Shaul’ khut panin nang kong honkhia hi.

Na ukpa’ inn, nangma tungah kong pia a, na ukpa’ zite nang aa dingin kong pia hi. Keimah in nang tungah Israyl innkuan leh Yahdah innkuan kong pia hi. Tua pen a kicing nai lo hi phial leh zong, a tamzaw tham kong pia lai ding hi.

Bang hangin Yahweh’ Thukham simmawh-in, Ama mit ah a sia gamta na hi hiam? Nangmah in namsau tawh Hit mi Uriyah sattukin, nangma zi dingin a zi na laksak hi. Nangmah in Ammon mite’ namsau tawh amah na that hi.
Hih thu hangin na inn leh namsau kikhen ngei lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in Kei nong simmawh a, na zi dingin Hit mi Uriyah’ zi na laksak hi.

Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En in, nangma inn sung pan mahmahin nang tungah tuahsiatna kong tungsak ding hi. Nangma mittang mai mahmah panin na zite ka la ding a, na kinaipih khat tungah ka pia ding hi; amah in suntangpi-in na zite luppih ding hi.
Nangmah in hih thu simtham takin na hih a, ahih hangin Keimah in Israyl khempeuh mai suntangpi-in hih thu ka hih ding hi, ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Nathan kiangah, “Yahweh tungah ka mawh hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Nathan in, “Yahweh in na mawhna paaikhia khin hi. Nang na si kei ding hi.
Ahih hangin hih bangin gamtatna tawh nangmah in Yahweh galte’ gensiat theih nadingin lak na hih manin na sunga piang na tapa a si ding hi,” a ci hi.
Nathan a inn ah a ciah khit ciangin Uriyah’ zi in David tawh a neih a ta Yahweh in vat a, amah a ci hong na hi.
David in naupang aa dingin Yahweh tungah thuum a, David in an tangin zanin leilak ah a lum hi.
Leilak panin a phongto dingin a inna upate a kiangah pai uh a, ahih hangin amah ut loin, amaute tawh an zong a ne nuam kei hi.

A ni sagihna ni-in naupang si hi. Naupang a sih lam ama kiangah a koh ding uh David’ nasemte a kihta uh hi. Amaute in, “Naupang a nuntak lai nangawnin amah i hopih ciangin i thu hong ngai lo hi. Naupang a sih lam bangci bangin gen ngam peuhmah ding i hi hiam? Siatna bawl kha ding hi!” ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.

David in a nasemte a kihuauna a muh ciangin naupang sita hi, ci-in a ummawh hi. Tua ciangin David in a nasemte kiangah, “Naupang si ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amaute in, “Amah si hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin leilak panin David tho-in kisil a, sathau kinilhin a puante a laih hi. Yahweh’ Inn sungah amah pai-in Yahweh a bia hi. Tua khit ciangin a inn ah pai-in an a nget ciangin amaute in an lui-in amah in a ne hi.

A nasemte in ama kiangah, “Hih banga na gamtat a bangci bang ahi hiam? Naupang a nuntak lai-in ama hangin an tangin na kap a, ahih hangin naupang a sih ciangin tho-in an na ne hi,” ci-in a dong uh hi.

Amah in amaute kiangah, “Naupang a hin lai-in an tangin ka kap hi; bang hang hiam cihleh, ‘Naupang a hin nadingin Yahweh in kei hong hehpih ding hiam, hong hehpih lo ding hiam, cih kua in theikhol ahi hiam?’ ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.

Ahih hangin tu-in amah sita a, bang hangin an tang ding ka hi hiam? Amah lakik thei ding ka hi hiam? Ama kiangah kei ka pai thei ding a, ahih hangin kei kiangah amah hong ciahkik thei lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
David in a zi Bathsheba hehnemin, ama kiangah pai-in amah tawh a lumkhawm hi. Tuanu in tapa khat nei a, David in a min Solomon phuakin, Yahweh in amah a it hi.
Yahweh in amah it ahih manin, kamsang Nathan tungtawnin thu puak a, amah in Yahweh’ itna hangin a min Yedidiyah; Yahweh it, ci-in a phuak hi.
Yahab in Ammon mite khuapi Rabbah simin a khuapi kulh muanhuai a la hi.
Yahab in David kiangah kamtaite sawlin, “Rabbah khuapi ka simzo a, a tuinek uh ka lazo hi.
Tu-in galkap a omlai teng kaikhawm inla, khuapi lang ah phual satin khuapi la in; tua hi kei leh keimah in khuapi la-in keima min pua kha ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin David in galkap khempeuh khawmin Rabbah ah a pai hi. Amaute in tua khuapi simin a man uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in Milcom’ lu tung panin kumpi-lukhu a la hi. A gikna pen kham talent khat hi a, suang manphate tawh a kizem hi. Tua pen David’ lu tungah kikhusak hi. Amah in khuapi panin van kinusia tampitak a la hi.

Amah in tua lai-a om mite paikhiatpihin sing-at ding, tuzum leh hei zanga nasem dingin koih hi. Amah in amaute leiseek seekna ah nasemsak hi. Amah in Ammon mite’ khuapi khempeuh ah hih bangin a hih hi. Tua ciangin David leh a galdo mi khempeuh, Yerusalem ah a ciah uh hi.
Hih thu khit ciangin, David’ tapa Absalom in sanggam numei mel hoih khat nei-in a min Tamar hi a, David’ tapa Amnon in tua nu a ngai hi.
Tamar tawh lem lo lua mahmah ahih manin a sanggamnu hangin Amnon a cinat lawh hi. Tuanu nungak bit khat hi a, ama tungah bang khatpeuh hih ding piang thei lo hi, ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
Amnon in David’ sanggampa Shimeah’ tapa a min Yahnadab kici lawm khat nei hi. Yahnadab pen zuau thu ah a tei mahmah khat ahi hi.

Amah in Amnon kiangah, “Kumpipa’ tapa aw, bang hangin ni khat khit ni khat gawng semsem na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amnon in ama kiangah, “Ka sanggampa Absalom’ sanggamnu Tamar ka ngai hi,” ci-in a gen hi.

Yahnadab in ama kiangah, “Na lupna tungah lum inla, a cina kineih in. Nang hong veh dingin na pa hong pai ciangin ama kiangah, ‘Ka sanggamnu Tamar ka kiangah hong pai-in an hong piasak in. Keimah in amah enin, ama khut panin an ka nek theih nadingin ka muhna ah an hong bawlsak in,’ ci in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin Amnon lumin, cina a kineih hi. Amah veh dingin kumpipa hong pai ciangin, Amnon in kumpipa kiangah, “Ka sanggamnu Tamar khut panin ka nek theih nadingin amah hong pai-in mohpheng pawlkhat hong bawlsak in,” a ci hi.
David in inn-a om Tamar kiangah kam vaikhakin, “Na sanggampa Amnon’ inn ah pai inla, ama aa dingin an bawlsak in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin a sanggampa Amnon’ inn ah Tamar pai a, amah na lum hi. Tuanu in annel la-in lom a, a muhna ah anlum bawlin a em hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in sikbeeldai la-in anlum a lui hangin a ne nuam kei hi. Tua khit ciangin Amnon in, “Ka kiang panin mi khempeuh sawlkhia in,” ci-in thu a pia hi. Tua ahih manin amaute khempeuh a pusuak uh hi.

Tua ciangin Amnon in Tamar kiangah, “Na khut tung panin ka nek theih nadingin lupna inndei sungah an hong paipih in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Tamar in a bawlsa anlum la-in lupna inndei-a a sanggampa Amnon kiangah a paipih hi.
A ne dingin ama kiangah a paipih ciangin, amah in tuanu mancipin, “Ka sanggamnu aw hong pai in, kei tawh hong lum khawm in,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin tuanu in ama kiangah, “Sanggam aw, hilo hi! Hong thatang kaih kei in! Israyl-te sungah tua bangin gamtat ding kilawm lo hi. Hi bangin gitloh gamtat kei in.

Kei bang suak ding ka hi hiam? Ka maizumna bangci sel ding ka hi hiam? Nang bang suak ding na hi hiam? Israyl sungah a gilo mihai khatin nang hong kingaihsun ding hi. Nong hehpihna-in kumpipa kiangah gen in: bang hang hiam cihleh amah in nong tenpih ding hong kham lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in tuanu thu ngai lo hi. Tuanu sangin amah hatzaw ahih manin thatanghat thu-in a luppih hi.
Tua ciangin Amnon in tuanu nakpi takin a mudah hi. Amah in a cil-a a itna sangin tu-a a muhdahna lianzaw hi. Tua ahih ciangin Amnon in tuanu kiangah, “Tho inla, paikhia in!” a ci hi.
Tuanu in ama kiangah, “Hilo hi! Tu-a kei tunga nong hihsa thu sangin kei nong sawlkhiat gitlohna pen siazaw hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in tuanu thu ngai lo hi.
Amah in a nasem neihtuampa samin, “Hih lai panin hih numei lakhia inla, ama nungah kong kalhsan in,” a ci hi.
Tuanu in puantualpi kizem a hoih khat a silh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kumpipa’ tanungak bitte in tua bang puan nam a silh uh hi. A nasempa in tuanu koihkhia-in, tuanu nungah kong a kalhsan hi.
Tua ciangin Tamar in a lu tungah vut koihin, a kizem a puantualpi hoih a balkek hi. Amah in a lu tungah a khutte koihin, nakpipi-in kap kawmin a paikhia hi.

Tuanu sanggampa Absalom in ama kiangah, “Na sanggampa Amnon nang tawh om ahi hiam? Ka sanggamnu aw, tu-in lungnuam takin om in. Amah pen na sanggampa ahi hi; hih thu lim ngaihsut lua kei in,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin a sanggampa inn ah lungneu takin a om hi.
Kumpi David in hih thu khempeuh a zak ciangin heh mahmah hi;
Ahih hangin Absalom in ama kiangah a pha ahi a, a sia ahi zongin bangmah gen lo hi; Ahih hangin Amnon in a sanggamnu tungah a bawlna hangin Absalom in amah mudah hi.
Kum nih bit khit ciangin Absalom in Ephraim-te gam nai-a Baal Hazar ah tuumul mette khawmin, Absalom in kumpipa’ tapate khempeuh tua lai-ah a sam hi.
Kumpipa kiangah Absalom pai-in, “Na nasempa in tuumul mette khawm hi. Na nasempa tawh kumpipa leh a nasemte nong pai ding hiam?” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin kumpipa in Absalom kiangah, “Hilo hi, ka tapa aw, i vekpi-in i pai kei ding hi, tua bang hi keileh nang aa dingin kote vangik ka hi kha ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in David kun veve a, ahih hangin David in a pai ding nialin, ahi zongin amah thupha a pia hi.

Tua ciangin Absalom in, “Nang nong pai theih kei ding leh, ko tawh ka sanggampa Amnon hong pai nadingin hong phal in,” a ci hi. Kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Bang hangin amah nang tawh hong pai ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Ahih hangin Absalom in kun tentan ahih manin kumpipa in Amnon leh kumpipa’ tapate khempeuh amah tawh a pai ding a phal hi.

Tu-in Absalom in a mite thupia khin a, “Ngai un! Amnon in leenggahzu khamin nuam a sak ciang leh keimah in note kiangah, ‘Amnon sattuk un,’ kong cih ciangin amah that un. Lau kei un, bang hang hiam cihleh keimah in note thu kong pia hi. Thahat unla hang un,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Absalom’ mite in Absalom thupiaksa bangin Amnon a hih uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa’ tapate khempeuh dingin a laa tung ciat uh ah tuangin a taimang uh hi.
Amaute lamkal ah a om laitakun, David kiangah hih thu kipuak a, “Absalom in kumpipa’ tapate khempeuh that hi! Khat beek siit lo hi!” a ci hi.
Kumpipa dingto-in a puante balkek a, leilak ah a puk hi. A kianga ding a nasemte khempeuh in zong a puante uh a balkek uh hi.

Ahih hangin David’ sanggampa Shimeah’ tapa Yahnadab in, “Ka ukpa aw amaute in kumpipa’ tapate khempeuh kithat hi, ci-in ngaihsun peuhmah kei in, bang hang hiam cihleh Amnon bek si hi. Amnon in a sanggamnu Tamar thatanghat thu tawh a hih ni-a kipanin, hih pen Absalom in a sawmsawmsa ahi hi.
Kumpipa’ tapa khempeuh sikhin hi, ci-in ka ukpa kumpipa aw a haksa lua-in ngaihsun kei in. Amnon bek si hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Absalom a tai hi. Tua ciangin galvil tangvalpa khuadakin, ama omna pan nitumna lam mualang panin mitampi paisuk a mu hi.
Yahnadab in kumpipa kiangah, “En in! Kumpipa’ tapate hong pai hi. Na nasempa gen bang teekteekin hong piang hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in a thugen a mankhit phetin, kumpipa’ tapate hong tungin amaute a kap beba uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa leh a nasemte khempeuh zong nakpi takin a kap uh hi.
Tua ciangin Absalom tai a, Geshur kumpipa Ammihud’ tapa Talmai kiangah a tung hi. Ahih hangin Kumpi David a tapa hangin nisimin a thuum hi.
Absalom tai-in Geshur ah a tun khit ciangin tua lai ah kum thum sung a om hi.
Amnon’ sihna tawh kisai-in kumpipa kihehnem hi; ahih hangin kumpi David kha; lungsim, Absalom kiangah a ut mahmah hi.
Kumpipa lungtang in Absalom a lunggulh lam Zeruyah’ tapa Yahab in a thei hi.

Tua ahih manin Yahab in Tekoa ah mi sawl a, tua lai panin numei pil khat la-in tuanu kiangah, “A thuumthuum kineih inla, dahna puansilhte silh in. Sathau kinilh kei inla, misi hangin sauveipi a thuumthum numei khat bangin kineih in.
Tua khit ciangin kumpipa kiangah pai inla, ama kiangah hih bangin gen in. Yahab in tuanu gen ding thu teng a hilh hi.
Tekoa-a numeinu in kumpipa kiangah thu a gen ciangin amah zahtakna-in leilak ah maipuk a, “Hong huh in, kumpipa aw!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Bang in hong lungkhamsak ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in dawngkikin, “Ka pasal si a, kei pen meigong ka hi taktakta hi.
Na nasemnu keimah in tapa nih ka nei a, gamlak ah amaute khat le khat a kilai uh hi. Amaute a khen ding mi omlo ahih manin a khat in adang khat satin a that hi.

Tu-in beh buppi in na nasemnu langah pang uh a, amaute in, “Ama thah sanggampa nuntakna hangin amah thu om bangin ka thah theih nadingun, a sanggampa a sattukpa hong ap in. Tua ciangin kote in a gamluahte zong ka susia ding uh hi. Ka pasal’ min ahi a, a suanlekhak ahi zongin leitung ah nusiatna tawh amaute in ka neih lai ka mei-am om lai sunsun hong lakkhiatsak ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in numeinu kiangah, “Na inn ah ciah in; nang tawh kisai-in a kisam bangin thu ka pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Tekoa numeinu in kumpipa kiangah, “Ka uk kumpipa aw, keima tung leh ka pa’ innkuan tungah mawhsakna om tahen; kumpipa leh a kumpi-tokhom mawhsakna om kei tahen,” a ci hi.
Kumpipa in, “Nang tungah khatpeuh in thu khatpeuh hong gen leh, kei kiangah hong paipih in; amah in nang hong buaisakkik nawn lo ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin amah in, “Kumpipa in na Pa Yahweh Min lo inla, ka tapa a kisuksiat loh nadingin sisan-phulapa a kisuksiat ding phal kei in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin David in, “Yahweh a nungta ahih mah bangin na tapa’ lu tunga om samzang khat beek leilak ah kia lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin numeinu in, “Na nasemnu in ka uk kumpipa kiangah thu dang kong gen thei lai ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Gen in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin numeinu in, “Tua ahih leh bang hangin Yahweh’ mite tungah tua tawh a kibang na hih sawm na hi hiam? Kumpipa in hih thu na gen ciangin na hawlkhiat na tapa inn ah samkik lo na hih manin kumpipa mahmah a kimawhsak hilo na hi hiam?

Eite khempeuh i si taktak ding a, a kikhawmkik thei lo leilaka a bua tui tawh i kibang ding hi. Ahih hangin Yahweh in nuntakna a lakhia mang kei ding hi; tua sangin Ama kiang panin a kihawlkhiate a kinotkhiat loh nadingin lampi a geelsak hi.

Mite in kei hong lauthawngsak uh ahih manin tu-in hih thu gen dingin ka uk kumpipa kiangah hong pai ka hi hi. Na nasemnu in, ‘Kumpipa kiangah thu ka gen ding a, amah in a nasemnu ngetna pia thei ding hi.
Yahweh in eite hong piak gamh panin kei leh ka tapa hong suksiat sawm mipa’ vangliatna panin kumpipa in hong theikha-in hong honkhia ding hi,’ ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.

Na nasemnu in, ‘Ka uk kumpipa’ kammal in nopsakna hong pia ding hi,’ ci-in ngaihsun hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ vantungmi bangin ka uk kumpipa in a sia leh a pha khentel thei hi. Yahweh na Pa in nang hong ompih tahen,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in numei kiangah, “Nang kong dot ding thu a dawnna hong im kei in,” a ci hi. Numei in, “Ka uk kumpipa aw hong gen in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “Hih thu khempeuh Yahab vaihawmna tawh hong pai na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Numei in, “Nang a nungta na hih mah bangin ka uk kumpipa aw, nong gensa khempeuh panin veilam ahi a, taklam ahi zongin kuamah pial thei lo hi. Na nasempa Yahab in kei hong hilhin, na nasemnu kam ah hih thute khempeuh hong koih hi.
Na nasem Yahab in tu laitaka omzia khel nadingin hih thu a hih ahi hi. Ka ukpa in leitunga a piang na khempeuh a thei Yahweh’ vantungmi pilna bangin pilna na nei hi,” a ci hi.
Kumpipa in Yahab kiangah, “Hoih mahmah hi, hih thu ka thukim hi. Pai inla tangvalpa Absalom hong ciahpihkik in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahab leilak ah maikunsuk a, zahtakna bawlin kumpipa tungah lungdam a ko hi. Yahab in, “Kumpipa in a nasempa ngetna phalkhin ahih manin na nasempa in na mit ah maipha ngah ahih lamtak tuni-in ka thei hi, ka uk kumpipa aw,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Geshur ah Yahab pai-in Yerusalem ah Absalom a ciahpihkik hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in, “Ama inn ah paisak un, ahih hangin amah in ka maitang hong mu lo ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Absalom ama inn ah ciahkik a, amah in kumpipa’ maitang mukha lo hi.
Israyl sung khempeuh ah ama melhoihna hangin Absalom zahin a kiphat khat zong omlo hi. A khetaw panin a luzang dong ama tungah paubanna a om kei hi.
Amah in a lu-a sam gik lua a sak hunhunin met a, a sam a met simin tehin kumpi vangik tehna shekel 200 a gik hi.
Absalom in tapa thum leh tanu khat a nei hi. A tanu min pen Tamar ahi hi. Amah pen numei melhoih khat ahi hi.
Yerusalem ah Absalom kum nih bit om a, ahih hangin amah in kumpipa’ maitang mukha lo hi.
Tua ciangin Absalom in kumpipa kiangah Yahab a sawl theih nadingin a vaikhak hangin Yahab ama kiangah a pai nuam kei hi. A nih veina nangawn a vaikhak hangin a pai nuam kei hi.

Tua ciangin amah in a nasemte kiangah, “En un, Yahab’ lo pen kei aa zom ah hi a, tua lai ah amah in mangbuh-ham a nei hi; pai unla mei tawh va hal un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Absalom’ nasemte pai-in tua lo mei tawh a hal uh hi.
Tua ciangin Absalom’ inn ah Yahab pai-in, amah in, “Bang hangin na nasemte in ka lo hong halsak uh ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Absalom in Yahab kiangah, “Nang kong vaikhak a, ‘Kumpipa kiangah nang kong sawlin: Bang hangin Geshur panin hong pai ka hi hiam? Tua lai ah om lai leng kei aa dingin hoihzaw ding hi. Tu-in kumpipa’ maitang ka mu nuam a, keima sungah khialna khatpeuh a om leh amah in kei hong thatsak in, ci-in kong gensak nuam hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa kiangah Yahab pai-in hih thu a gen hi. Amah in Absalom a sap ciangin, kumpipa kiangah amah pai-in kumpipa mai lei ah maikunin a boksuk hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in Absalom a nam hi.
Hih thu khit ciangin Absalom in ama mai-a tai dingin sakol leeng khat leh sakolte leh mi sawmnga a kithawisak hi.

Absalom tho baih-in khuapi kulh kongpi zuatna lampi gei ah a ding hi. Kumpipa kiangah thukhensak dingin thubuai a nei mi khatpeuh a pai simin Absalom in amah samin, “Bang khua panin hong pai na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Na nasempa pen Israyl minamte khat pan ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Absalom in ama kiangah, “En in, na thubuai pen dikin kician sinsen hi; ahih hangin na thu hong sit dingin kumpipa’ tanga thukhen ding mi a om kei hi,” a ci hi.

Absalom in, “Gam sungah kei thukhenin hong kikoih hizen leh aw! Lungkimlohna a nei ahih keileh thu nei khatpeuh ka kiangah hong pai ding uh a, keimah in ama tungah thu a tang takin ka khen ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ama tungah zahtakna a bawl dingin mi khatpeuh a nai-ah hong pai ciangin Absalom in a khut zan a, amah kawi-in a nam hi.
Hih bangin Absalom in kumpipa kiangah thutang khensatna a dong dingin a pai Israyl khempeuh tua bangin a bawl hi. Tua ahih manin Absalom in Israyl mite lungsim a zo hi.
Kum li a cin ciangin Absalom in kumpipa kiangah, “Yahweh tungah ka ciamsa ka thuciam a tangtungsak dingin Hebron ah ka pai ding hong phal in.
Aram gam sung Geshur ah ka om lai-in na nasempa kiciamna khat ka kiciam a, ‘Yerusalem ah Yahweh in kei hong ciahpihkik leh, keimah in Yahweh kong bia ding hi,’ ka ci hi,” a ci hi.
Kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Lungnuam takin pai in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah dingto-in Hebron ah a pai hi.
Tua ciangin Absalom in Israyl minam sung khempeuh ah kamtai sawlsim a, “Peengkul aw na zak phetun, ‘Hebron ah Absalom in uk hi!’ ci un,” a ci hi.
Yerusalem panin Absalom tawh mi 200 pai uh hi; amaute a kisam mawk lel hi a, mawhbaang loin a pai uh hi. Amaute in tua thu bangmah thei lo uh hi.
Absalom in biakpiaknate a piakna mun Giloh-a a khuapi panin David’ thukuppihpa Gilon mi Ahithophel a samsak hi. Absalom nungzui mite khangkhang ahih manin sawmsimna hong thahat semsem hi.
Kamtai khat hong pai-in David kiangah thupuak a, “Israyl mite lungsim Absalom lamah paikhin hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin David in Yerusalem-a amah tawh a om a uliante khempeuh kiangah, “Pai un! I tai hamtang ding hi, tua hi keileh Absalom kiang panin i suakta kei ding hi. Manglangin pai ni; tua hi keileh amah in eite hong pha pak ding a, eite tungah siatna hong tungsakin namsau tawh khuapi sung hong vat ding hi.
Kumpipa’ uliante in kumpipa dawngin, “Ko hong uk kumpipa thupiak peuhpeuh a sem dingin kote pen nangma nasemte ka hi uh hi,” a ci hi.
Kumpipa dingkhia-in ama innkuan buppi in amah a zui hi; ahih hangin a inn a kem dingin amah in a zineute ahi numei sawm nusia hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa paikhia-in a mite khempeuh in amah zui uh a, a gamla simsim mun khat ah a khawl uh hi.
Chereth mite khempeuh, Peleth mite khempeuh tawh a mite khempeuh in amah makhelh uh hi. Gath panin Gath mite zaguk khempeuh in zong kumpipa mai-ah a khengsuak uh hi.

Kumpi David in Gath mi Ittai kiangah, “Bang hangin ko tawh hong pai ding na hi hiam? Ciahkik inla, “Kumpipa” tawh om in; bang hang hiam cihleh nang pen gamdang mi khat na hi a, na pianna gam mahmah panin hong kihawlkhia khat zong na hi hi.

Zanni-a hong tung pan bek na hi hi. Ka pai nading mun ka theih lohna ah tuni in nang hong kawivakpih ding ka hi hiam? Ciahkik inla, na sanggamte tonpih in. Migitna leh cihtakna nang tawh hong om tahen,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Ittai in kumpipa dawngin, “Yahweh a nungta-in ka uk kumpipa a nungta na hih mah bangin ka uk kumpipa omna mun peuhpeuh ah a nungta ahi a, a si ahi zongin tua lai ah na nasempa zong ka om ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin David in Ittai kiangah, “Pai masa in, paisuak in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Gath mi Ittai, a mi khempeuh leh amah tawh a innkuante a paisuak uh hi.
Tua mite khempeuh in a nawk uh khuaneute khempeuh nakpi takin a kapkhia uh hi. Kumpipa mahmah in zong Kidron Lui kantanin mite khempeuh in sehnel gam lam a manawh uh hi.

Tua lai-ah Zadok zong om a, amah tawh Levi mi khempeuh in Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang a pua uh hi. Amaute in Yahweh’ singkuang nga uh a, mite khempeuh khuapi panin a pusuah khit matengun Abiathar a paito hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Zadok kiangah, “Khuapi sungah Yahweh’ singkuang puakkik un. Yahweh mit ah maipha ka ngah leh, Amah in kei hong puakkik ding a, tua ciangin Ama tenna mun hong musakkik ding hi.
Ahih hangin Amah in, ‘Nang tungah lungkimna ka nei kei hi,’ hong cih leh, tua ciangin hih lai-ah kei ka om ding hi. Amah in man a sak bangin kei tungah hong bawl tahen,” a ci hi.

Kumpipa in siampi Zadok kiangah hih zong gen lai a, “Nang thumukhol thei khat hilo na hi hiam? Na tapa Ahimaaz leh Abiathar’ tapa Yahnathan tawh khuapi ah lungnuam takin ciahkik in. Nang leh Abiathar in na tapa tegel uh tonpih un.
No kiang panin zaksakna kammal hong tun mateng gamlak zanglei ah ka na ngak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Zadok leh Abiathar in Yerusalem ah Yahweh’ singkuang paipihkikin, tua lai-ah amaute a om uh hi.
Olive Mual tungah David paitoto-in, a pai kawmkawmin a kap hi; Amah in a lu khuhin, a khe guakin a pai hi. Amah tawh a om mi khempeuh in zong a lute uh khuhin, a pai kawmkawmin a kap uh hi.
Tu-in David thu kipuakin, “Ahithophel zong a sawmsimte lakah Absalom tawh om hi,” a kici hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in thungenin, “Yahweh aw, Ahithophel’ kuppihnate haina-in na heisak in!” a ci hi.
Mual dawn ah David a tun ciangin, amah in tua lai-ah Yahweh a bia hi. Tua ciangin amah tawh kimu dingin Ark mi Hushai, a puankeksa leh a lu tungah leivui omsa-in hong tung hi.
David in ama kiangah, “Kei tawh nong paikhop leh kei aa dingin vangik khat na hi ding hi.

Ahi zongin khuapi ah ciahkikin, Absalom kiangah, ‘Kumpipa aw, na nasem kong hi ding hi; a beisa-in na pa’ nasem ka hi a, ahi zongin tu-in nangma nasem ka hi ding hi,’ ci lecin, Ahithophel’ ngaihsutdan leh kuppihna zo-in nawngkaisakna tawh kei nong huh thei kha ding hi.
Siampite ahi Zadok leh Abiathar tua lai-ah nang tawh ding hilo ahi hiam? Kumpipa’ inn panin na zak peuhpeuh siampite ahi Zadok leh Abiathar kiangah gen in.
A tapa tenih: Zadok’ tapa Ahimaaz leh Abiathar’ tapa Yahnathan-te, tua lai-ah amaute tawh om hi. Na zak peuhpeuh amaute tungtawnin kei nong zasak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin khuapi sungah David’ lawm Hushai tung a, Yerusalem ah Absalom a lut hi.

David in mual dawn a khenkhit deuh ciangin, amah a dawn dingin Mephibosheth’ nasempa Ziba in tua lai-ah ngakin na om hi. Amah in anlum zanih, leenggah phehkeu bawk zakhat, thei moh za khat leh leenggahzu savun um khat a pua van a kivawh laate tawh amah na om hi.

Kumpipa in Ziba kiangah, “Bang hangin hihte hong paipih na hi hiam!” a ci hi. Ziba in, “Laate pen kumpipa’ innkuanpihte a tuan nading uh hi a, ante pen tangvalte’ nek ding hi a, leenggahzu pen gamlak ah a zawmte thathak ngah nading ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “Na ukpa’ tupa koi ah om ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Ziba in kumpipa kiangah, “Yerusalem ah amah om lai hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in a lungsim sungah, ‘Tuni-in Israyl innkuan in ka pu’ kumpigam kei tungah hong piakik ding hi,’ ci-in a ngaihsun hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in Ziba kiangah, “Mephibosheth’ neihsa khempeuh tu-in nang aa hita hi,” a ci hi. Ziba in, “Nangma mai-ah kiniamkhiat takin kong kunsuk hi. Ka uk kumpipa aw, nangma muhna ah maipha hong ngahsak in,” a ci hi.
Kumpi David Bahurim a manawh laitakin Shaul innkuan tawh a beh kibang mi khat tua lai panin hong paikhia a, a min Shimei hi a, Gera’ tapa ahi hi. Hamsiat kawmkawmsa-in amah hong paikhia hi.
David vei leh tak ah amah a tuam vilvel-a a cingte leh a galhangte khempeuh om napi-in David leh kumpipa’ uliante khempeuh suangte tawh a deng hi.
Shimei in amah a hamsiatna-in hih thu gen a, “Paikhia in, paikhia in, no mihing sisan suahte! No kimanna neilo mi vakthapte!

Ama mun ah na ukna Shaul’ innkuan sunga na sisan suah khempeuh hanga Yahweh in nang hong thukkik hi. Yahweh in na tapa Absalom khut sungah kumpigam piazo hi. Nang pen sisan suah mi khat na hih manin a kisia na hita hi.
Tua ciangin Zeruyah’ tapa Abishai in kumpipa kiangah, “Bang hangin hih ui sisa khat lel in ka kumpipa hong hamsiat ahi hiam? Keimah pai-in a lutang ka tankhiat ding hong phal in,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin kumpipa in, “No Zeruyah’ tapate aw, no leh kei in bang nei khawm i hi hiam? Tua ahih manin samsiasak lel un. Yahweh in ama kiangah, ‘David samsia in!’ cikhin ahih leh, kua in, ‘Hih bangin gamta na hi hiam’ ci thei ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua khit ciangin David in Abishai leh a uliante khempeuh kiangah, “Ka sung mahmah pana piang ka tapa in ka nuntakna hong lak sawm hi. Tua hi a, hih Benyamin mipa ahi cih zawk tham ding mah ahi hi! Amah kia koihkhong lel un, samsiasak lel un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in amah thupia khin hi.
Yahweh in ka thuakna hong mu ding a, tuni-a ka ngah samsiatna tangin dikna tawh hong thuk ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin ama galkhat mualpang ah Shimei a pai laitakin David leh a mite lamdung ah paipai uh a, Shimei in a paikawmin samsia a, suang tawh amah dengin leivui a theh hi.
Kumpipa leh amah tawh a om a mite khempeuh, a paina mun uh ah tawl mahmahin tung uh a, ahih hangin tua lai-ah amaute a kitawldamsak uh hi.
Tua hun laitakin Yerusalem ah Absalom leh a mite khempeuh tung uh a, amah tawh Ahithophel a om hi.
Absalom kiangah David’ lawm Ark mi Hushai hong pai ciangin amah in, “Kumpipa khan sawt tahen! Kumpipa khan sawt tahen!” a ci hi.
Absalom in Hushai kiangah, “Na lawmpa aa dinga na migitna hi bang himawk maw? Bang hangin na lawmpa tawh tai lo na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Hushai in Absalom kiangah, “Hilo hi, Yahweh, hih mite leh Israyl mi khempeuh teelpa’ aa dingin kei ka hi ding a, amah tawh ka om khawm ding hi.
Tua banah ke’n kua na sem ding ka hi hiam? A tapa’ na sem lo ding ka hi hiam? Na pa’ na ka sep bang teekteekin nangma na ka sem ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Absalom in Ahithophel kiangah, “Bang cih ding i hi hiam cih vaihawm dan ding leh na ngaihsutna hong gen in,” a ci hi.

Ahithophel in Absalom kiangah, “Na pa in inn cing dingin a nusiat na pa’ zineute tawh lum in. Tua ciangin na pa’ tungah a huathuai-in na kibawlna thu Israyl khempeuh in za ding uh a, nang tawh a om khempeuh’ tha khauhsak ding hi,”a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in Absalom aa dingin innkhum zang ah puanbuk khat lamsak uh a, Israyl khempeuh muhna ah Absalom in a pa’ zineute luppih hi.

Tua hun lai-a Ahithophel vaihawmna leh ngaihsutna a piakte pen Yahweh’ thu a dong mi khat tawh kibangin a kingaihsun hi. Tua bangin David leh Absalom in Ahithophel’ vaihawmna leh ngaihsutna a thupi sim uh hi.
Ahithophel in Absalom kiangah hih ngaihsut a pia hi: “Keimah in mi 12,000 ka teel ding a, tuzan mahmahin David a delh dingin ka sawl ding hi.
Amah gimin a thanem laitakin ka do ding hi. Lipkhap huai takin amah ka sat ding a, tua ciangin amah tawh a om mi khempeuh taikek ding uh hi. Kumpipa bek ka sat tuk ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin nang kiangah mi khempeuh kong paipihkik ding hi. Na zon mipa khat bek’ sihna in a vekpi-a nuamtakin ciahkikna suak ding hi.
Hih vaihawmna leh ngaihsutna in Absalom leh Israyl upate khempeuh lungkimsak hi.
Tua ciangin Absalom in, “Tu-in Ark mi Hushai sam unla, ama genna zong ngai ni,” a ci hi.
Absalom kiangah Hushai a tun ciangin, Absalom in ama kiangah, “Ahithophel in hih thu hong gen hi. Ama gen bangin i sem ding hiam? Ahih kei leh nang hong gen in,” a ci hi.
Hushai in Absalom kiangah, “Ahithophel hong piak vaihawmna leh ngaihsutna pen tuhuna hih dingin kilawm nai lo hi,” a ci hi.

Hushai in a thugen zom lai-in, “Na pa leh a mite na theihsa ahi hi: amaute pen galsiamte hi a, a note a kilaksak gamlak vompi hangsan bangin a hangsan mahmah uh hi. Tua bek tham loin na pa pen gal dodosa khat hi a, zanin a galkap honpi tawh a om khawm kei ding hi.

Tu-in amah pen kuahawm sung ahih keileh mun dang khatpeuh ah kibu taktak ding hi. Kisim cilna ah mi pawlkhat a sih ciangin tua thu a za peuhmah in, ‘Absalom a zui galkapte lakah kithahna om hi,’ ci ding uh hi.

Tua ciangin humpinelkai lungtang bangin lungtang a nei galkap hangsan pen’ lungsim nangawn tuisuak kiuhkeuh ding hi. Na pa galsiam ahihna leh amah tawh a omte pen mi hangsante ahihna Israyl khempeuh in thei uh hi.

Tua ahih manin keimah in kong kuppih nop leh kong ngaihsut piak nop inah: Dan panin Beersheba dong tuipi nawl-a sehnel bangin a tam Israyl khempeuh nang kiangah kaikhawm in; tua hileh nangmah in amaute gal sungah na makaih thei ding hi.

Tua ciangin eite in amah a kimuhna peuhpeuh ah i do ding a, leilaka van daitui kia bangin ama tungah eite i kia ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah leh amah tawh a om mi khempeuh khat nangawn zong kisiit lo ding hi.
Khuapi khat sungah amah a tai leh, Israyl khempeuh in tua khuapi ah khauhualte paipihin, tua lai-ah tua khuapi a them zong a kimu nawn lo zah dongin kuam sungah i kaimang ding hi,” a ci hi.

Absalom leh Israyl mi khempeuh in, “Ark mi Hushai’ kuppihna leh ngaihsutna pen Ahithophel’ aa sangin hoihzaw hi,” ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Absalom tungah siatna a tun theih nadingin Ahithophel’ kuppihna leh ngaihsutna hoih a mawkna suakin a kizawh nadingin Yahweh in a sehsa ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Hushai in siampite ahi Zadok leh Abiathar zasakin, “Tua bang tua bangin Ahithophel in Absalom leh Israyl upate ngaihsutna pia a, keimah in tua bang tua bangin ka kuppih hi.

Tu-in manlang takin mi sawlin David kiangah, “Gamlak zangleite ah tuzan giak nawn kei inla, manlang takin galkah in; tua hi kei leh kumpipa leh amah tawh a om mi khempeuh in hong kivalhtum ding hi,” a ci hi.

Yahnathan leh Ahimaaz-te khuapi sungah a lut uh a kimuh ding lauhuai ahih manin En Rogel ah amaute om uh hi. Nasem numei khat in amaute kiangah pai-in thu a puak ding hi a, Kumpi David kiangah amaute pai-in thu a puak ding ahi uh hi.

Ahih hangin pasalno khat in amaute mu-in Absalom kiangah a gen hi. Ahih hangin amau tegel manlang takin taikhia-in, Bahurim-a mi khat’ inn ah a tung uh hi. Amah in a huang sungah tuikhuk khat nei ahih manin amaute tua lai-ah a kumsuk uh hi.
Tua ciangin a zi in a khuhna la-in tuikhuk gong tungsan ah phah a, tua tungah an a zalh hi. Kuamah in tua thu thei lo uh hi.

Tua inna om numeinu kiangah Absalom’ mite a tun uh ciangin amaute in, “Ahimaaz leh Yahnathan koi-ah om ahi uh hiam?” a ci hi. Numeinu in amaute kiangah, “Amaute lui gal ah paikhin uh hi,” a ci hi. Amaute in zong kawikawi uh a, a muh loh ciangin Yerusalem ah a ciah uh hi.

A zong mite a paikhiat khit ciangin, tuikhuk panin amaute kahto-in Kumpi David thu a puak dingin a pai uh hi. Amaute in ama kiangah, “Dingkhia inla, tu mahmahin gun kantan in; Ahithophel in nang langah tua bang tua bangin thu gen khin hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin David leh amah tawh a om a mite khempeuh ding-in Yardan kantan uh hi. Khuavak ciangin Yardan a kantan nai lo khat beek a om nawn kei uh hi.

Ahithophel in ama kuppihna leh a ngaihsutna-te a kizuih loh lam a muh ciangin, amah in a laa tutphah vawhin a khuapi-a a inn ah a ciah hi. Amah in a innkuan vai hawmsak a, tua khit ciangin amahmah a kigui-awk hi. Amah si-in a pa’ han ah kivui hi.
Mahanaim ah David pai a, Absalom in amah leh amah tawh a om Israyl mi khempeuh tawh Yardan a kantan hi.

Absalom in Yahab mun ah galkap uk dingin Amasa a koih hi. Hih Amasa pen Israyl mi khat ahi a min Yithra kici pasal’ khat tapa hi a, Yithra in Yahab’ nu ahi Zeruyah’ sanggamnu Nahash’ tanu Abigail a tenpih hi.
Gilead ah Israyl leh Absalom in giahphual a sat uh hi.
Mahanaim ah David a tun ciangin, Rabbah panin Ammon mi Nahash’ tapa Shobi, Lo Debar panin Ammiel’ tapa Machir leh Rogelim panin Gilead mi Barzillai-te in,
lupna puante, kuangte leh leibeel nazatte puak uh hi. Amaute in mangbuh, mangbuh-ham leh annel leh an kansa, bepi leh besan,

khuaizu, nawithau khal, tuu leh bawngnawi khalte zong David leh amah tawh a om a mite nek dingin a puak hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in, “Gamlak ah mite gilkialin gim uh a, dangtak uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
David in amah tawh a om mite sim a, a tultul ukte, a zaza ukte a seh hi.

Tua khit ciangin David in galkapte khen thum suah a, khenkhat Yahab ukna nuai ah, khenkhat Yahab’ sanggampa Zeruyah’ tapa Abishai ukna nuai ah, khenkhat Gath mi Ittai ukna nuai-ah koihin mite a kuankhiasak hi. Kumpipa in mite kiangah, “Keimah zong note tawh kong kuankhia taktak ding hi,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin mite in, “Kote tawh nong kuankhia peuhmah kei ding hi. Kote ka taimang uh leh, amaute in kote hong awlmawh lo ding uh hi. Kote alang bang ka sih phial uh hangin amaute in kote hong awlmawh lo ding uh hi. Tua lai-ah ko tawh a kibang linlian tul sawm val om hilo ahi hiam? Tua ahih manin tu-in khuapi panin kote huhna hong puakin hong panpih lecin hoihzaw hi,” a ci uh hi.
Kumpipa in dawngin, “Hoih nasak penpenin ka gamta ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin mi khempeuh a tultul a zaza-in a kuankhiat laitakun kulh kongpi gei-ah kumpipa a ding hi.

Tu-in kumpipa in Yahab, Abishai leh Ittai thupia-in, “Kei nong khualna-un tangvalpa Absalom hong dopsak un,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in Absalom tawh kisai-in galkap ukte khat ciat tunga a thupiakte, galkap khempeuh in a za uh hi.
Israyl sim dingin gamlak ah kuankhia uh a, kidona pen Ephraim gammang tulak ah ahi hi.
David’ mite mai tua lai-ah Israyl’ galkapte kizo a, tua ni-in tua lai-ah a kithat tam mahmah a, mi 20,000 a si hi.
Khuaneu buppi ah galkidona kizel a, tua ni-a namsau thah sangin gammang tulak’ nektum nuntakna tamzaw hi.

Absalom a laa tungah a om laitakin David’ mite in Absalom tuakkha uh hi. Tawsaw lianpi hiang pha mahmah nuai-ah a laa tai-in, Absalom’ lutang tawsaw kawm ah awk hi. Ama nuai-a laa taisuak ahih manin vante leh lei kikal ah amah a kikhai hi.
A hici omna tua mite khat in a muh ciangin amah in Yahab kiangah gen a, “Tawsaw kung khat ah Absalom kikhai ka mu hi,” a ci hi.

Yahab in ama kiangah thu a puak mipa kiangah, “Bang e! Amah mu ing e? Bang hangin leilak ah sattuk suk pah lo na hia? Tua cih lecin ngun shekel sawm leh galhang kawnggak hong pia ngel ding hi veng,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin mipa in, “Ngun shekel 1000 nangawn ka khut sungah hong kipiak hangin, kumpipa’ tapa tungah ka khut ka liik kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh kumpipa in nang, Abishai leh Ittai kiangah, ‘Kuakua na hi uh zongin tangvalpa Absalom na hu un,’ hong ci hi.

Tua banah ka nuntakna a siat nadingin a khemtat ka hi ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kumpipa in a theih loh thu bangmah omlo hi; tua bangin mawhsakna thuak mah leng zong nangmah in kei nong hu kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahab in, “Hih bangin nang hong ngak man nawn kei ning!” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah in teipi thum la-in tawsaw kung tunga a hing lai-a kikhai Absalom’ lungtang ah a khawhsuk hi.
Tua ciangin Yahab’ galvanpua mi sawm in Absalom umcih uh a, amaute in satin a that uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahab in peengkul muutin, Yahab in galkapte khawlsak ahih manin Israyl-te delhna panin mite a khawl uh hi.
Amaute in Absalom lakhia-in gammang tulak dum lianpi khat ah pai uh a, ama tungah suangtum tampitak a ciannelh uh hi. Tua hun sungin Israyl mite khempeuh a inn uh ah a taimang uh hi.

Ama nuntak sungin Absalom in khuampi khat la-in amahmah aa dingin Kumpipa’ Kuam ah a phut hi. Amah in, “Keima min phawkna a pua ding tapa ka nei kei hi,” ci-in a ngaihsun hi. Tua ahih manin amah in tua khuapi ama min puasakin, tuni dongin Absalom’ Mual; Mualsuang, kici hi.
Tua ciangin Zadok’ tapa Ahimaaz in, “Keimah vatai-in, Yahweh in a galte khut panin amah a hotkhiat khitna thuthak kumpipa kiangah hong kosak in,” a ci hi.
