Ahih hangin Yahab in ama kiangah, “Tuni-in hih thuthak na va ko peuhmah kei ding hi. Hih thuthak ni dang ciangin na ko thei ding a, ahih hangin tuni-in thuthak khat zong na ko kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kumpipa’ tapa si hi,”a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahab in Cush mipa thupia-in, “Pai unla, na muh bangun kumpipa kiangah thu va ko un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Yahab mai-ah Cush mipa kunsukin a tai uh hi.

Zadok’ tapa Ahimaaz in Yahab kiangah, “Bang bang hitaleh Cush mipa nungah kei zong hong taisak in,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin Yahab in, “Ka tapa aw, thuthak a ko lo ding veve bang hangin va tai ding na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Amah in dawngin, “Bang bang hitaleh hong taisak hoh in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Yahab in ama kiangah, “Tai in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yardan zanglei lam tawnin Ahimaaz tai a, Cush mipa a makhelh hi.
Tu-in David pen kulh kongpi tenih kikalah a na tu hi. Galvilpa kulh kongpi khumzang ah kahto-in, a khuadak ciangin amah bek a hong tai mi khat a mu hi.
Tua khit ciangin galvilpa in kumpipa samin a gen hi. Kumpipa in, “Amah kia ahih leh, thu hoih hong puak hi hamtang ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua mipa pai-in hong nai semsem hi.

Tua khit ciangin galvilpa in midang a tai khat mu a, amah in kong cingpa samsukin, “ En dih in, mi khat zong hong tai leuleu hi!” a ci hi. Kumpipa in, “Amah in zong thu hoih hong puak hi limlim ding hi,” a ci hi.
Galvilpa in, “A masa-a hong taipa pen Zadok’ tapa tawh kisun sa ing,” a ci hi. Kumpipa in, “Amah mi hoih khat hi a, ama’n thu hoih hong tun ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Ahimaaz in samin, kumpipa kiangah, “A vekin hoih hi!” a ci hi. Tua khit ciangin kumpipa mai-ah a mai leilam ngatin kunsuk a, “Kumpipa’ langpana a khut a liik mite kiang panin hong hukhia Yahweh na Pa in phatna ngah tahen!” a ci hi.

Kumpipa in, “Tangvalpa Absalom a suakta hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Ahimaaz in, “Yahab in kumpipa’ na sempa leh na nasempa kei hong sawl lai-in buaina lianpi khat ka mu a, ahih hangin bang hiam cih ka thei kei hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Kumpipa in, “Kihei-in ding inla, hiah ngak in!” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah kihei-in a ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin Cush mipa hong tungin, “Ka kumpipa aw! Thu hoih na za in! Na langa a pang khempeuh kiang panin tuni-in Yahweh in nang hong hukhin hi!” a ci hi.
Kumpipa in Cush mipa kiangah, “Tangvalpa Absalom a suakta hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Cush mipa in, “Ka kumpipa’ galte leh nang hong nasak nuam-a dingte khempeuh tua tangvalpa bang hi tahen,” a ci hi.

Kumpipa a ling gawp hi. Kulh kongpi tunga inndei ah amah paito-in a kap hi. A paitoh kawmin amah kap a, “Ka tapa Absalom aw! Ka tapa, ka tapa Absalom! Nang tangin kei a si hizaw leng maw! O ka tapa Absalom, ka tapa aw!” a ci hi.
“Absalom hangin kumpipa kapkapin thuumthuum hi,” ci-in Yahab kiangah kiko hi.
Tua ahih manin galkap khempeuh aa dingin tua ni-a gualzawhna pen thuumna a suak hi; bang hang hiam cihleh galkapte in tua ni-in, ‘Kumpipa a tapa hangin dah hi,’ ci-in a kigenna a za uh hi.
Galsimna panin a tai-te maizumin a lutsim khiankhian bangin tua ni-in mipite khuapi sungah a lutsim khiankhian uh hi.
Kumpipa in a mai khuhin, kap khia a, “Ka tapa Absalom aw! Aw Absalom, ka tapa” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiang inn sungah Yahab lutin, “Nangma nuntakna, na tanute leh na tapate nuntakna, na zite leh na zineute nuntakna tuni-a hong hukhia na mite khempeuh na maizumsak hi.

Nangmah in nang hong mudahte na it a, nang hong itte na mudah hi! Na galkap mangte leh na mite bangmah lo hi, ci-in tuni-in na kilangsak hi. Hi taktak hi, tuni-in Absalom nungta-in kote khempeuh a si hi le ung na nuam ding lam ka thei hi.

Tu-in dingto in! Paikhia inla, na mite tha pia in. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh tungah ka kiciam hi: nang na paikhiat kei leh, tuzan ciangin nang tawh mi khat beek om nawn lo ding hi. Na neu tunga kipan tuhun donga na tuahsiatna khempeuh sangin hih pen nang aa dingin siazaw lai ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa dingto-in, kulh kongpi ah a tu hi. “Kumpipa kulh kongpi ah tu hi,” ci-in mite kiko hi; tua ahih manin amaute khempeuh ama mai-ah hong pai uh hi. Ahih hangin Israyl-te khempeuh a inn ciat uhah taimang khin hi.

Israyl minam sung khempeuh ah mi khempeuh kinial ngeingai-in, “Kumpipa in i galte khut panin eite hong hon a, Philistia-te khut panin eite hong hu hi; ahih hangin tu-in Absalom hangin a gam panin amah tai hi.
Eite hong uk dingin sathau i nilhpa Absalom, gal sungah si ta hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin kumpipa sapkik ding thu gen lo na hi uh hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin kumpi David in siampite ahi Zadok leh Abiathar kiangah mi sawlin, “Yahdah upate kiangah, ‘Israyl sung khempeuh ah kumpipa ama mun ah omsakkik dingin a kigen nungsangin bang hangin note in kumpipa a inn ah a ciahpih nunung pen hi ding na hi uh hiam?
Note pen ka sanggamte na hi uh hi. Ka guh leh ka satak na hi uh hi. Tua hi napi-in bang hangin kumpipa a inn ah a ciahpih nunung pen hi ding na hi uh hiam?’ ci-in dong un.

Tua khit ciangin Amasa kiangah, ‘Nang pen ka guh leh ka satak hilo na hi hiam? Tu-a kipan mailam ah ka galkap mangpa dingin Yahab mun ah kong koih kei tak leh Yahweh in a ut bangin hong bawlin a nasiazaw-in zong hong bawl tahen, ci hi’ ci un” a ci hi.
Amah in Yahdah mite khempeuh mi khat bangin amaute khempeuh’ lungsim a zo hi. Amaute in kumpipa kiangah thu puak uh a, “Nang leh na mite khempeuh hong ciahkik un,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa ciahkik a, Yardan ah a tung hi. Kumpipa a dawn ding leh Yardan a kantanpih dingin Gilgal ah Yahdah-te na tungkhin uh hi.
Bahurim panin Benyamin mi Gera’ tapa Shimei zong Yahdah mite tawh kumpi David dawn dingin manlangin a kuansuk hi.
Amah pen Benyamin mi tul khat leh Shaul’ innsung neihsa kempa Ziba leh a tapa sawm nga leh a nasem sawm nih tawh ahi hi. Kumpipa mai Yardan ah amaute a taisuk henhan uh hi.
Amaute in kumpipa’ innkuante a galkahpih ding leh a deihna bangbang a sepsak dingin ngahmun ah a galkah uh hi. Gera’ tapa in Yardan a kantan khit ciangin kumpipa mai-ah amah kunsuk hi.

Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa kiangah, “Ka kumpipa aw hong mawhsak kei in. Ka kumpipa in Yerusalem a nusiat ni-in na nasempa khialhna ciamteh kei in. Kumpipa in tua thu a ngaihsutna panin paikhia tahen.

Bang hang hiam cihleh na nasempa keimah in ka mawhkhit lam ka thei hi; ahih hangin tuni-in ka kumpipa kiangah paisukin a dawn dingin Yahseph innkuan buppi panin a masa penin hih lai-ah kong tung hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Zeruyah tapa Abishai in dawngin, tua ciangin “Amah in Yahweh’ sathau nilhsa mipa a samsiat nungsang hih thu hangin Shimei thah huai hilo ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

David in, “Nang leh kei in i neihkhop bang om ahi hiam, Zeruyah’ tapate aw? Tuni-in kei aa dingin note pen ka galte na suak uh hi! Tuni-in Israyl sungah mi khatpeuh thah ding kilawm ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cihleh tuni-in Israyl tungah kumpi ka hih lam thei lo ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin kumpipa in Shimei kiangah, “Na si kei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua khit ciangin kumpipa in kiciamna tawh a kamciam hi.

Kumpi David a dawn dingin Shaul’ tupa Mephibosheth zong hong paisuk hi. Kumpipa a paikhiat ni-a kipan lungnuam takin hong tunkik ni dong amah in a khe zong awlmawh loin, a khamulte zong meet lo a, a puante zong sawp lo hi.
Kumpipa dawn dingin Mephibosheth in Yerusalem a nusiat ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Mephibosheth aw, bang hangin kei hong zui lo na hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Mephibosheth in, “Kumpipa aw, ka nasempa in hong lehhek hi. Keimah na nasempa khebai ka hih manin keimah in, ‘Kumpipa tawh ka paikhop theih nadingin ka laa tutphah hong vawhsak in, tua ciangin a tungah ka tuang ding hi,’ ka cih hangin kei aa dingin hong kihihsak lo hi.
Amah in kumpipa kiangah na nasempa thu hong siatgen lai hi. Kumpipa pen Yahweh’ vantungmi tawh na kibang hi; tua ahih manin na mit ah man nasak bangin hong hih in.

Kumpipa mai-ah ka pu’ innkuan khempeuh thahlup ding vive hi napi-in, nangmah in na sabuai-a an a nete lak ah na nasempa keimah nong koih hi. Tua ahih manin kumpipa tungah kong nget thuah lai ding bang nei nawn ka hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Bang gen lailai na hi hiam? Nang leh Ziba in lote na hawm dingun thu kong pia hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Mephibosheth in kumpipa kiangah, “Kumpipa a inn ah lungnuam takin hong ciahkhin na hih nungsang tua sangin a vekin amah lasak in,” a ci hi.
Kumpipa tawh Yardan kantan ding leh Yardan panin lampi ah a kha dingin Rogelim panin Gilead mi Barzillai zong paisuk hi.
Barzillai pen a ham mahmah ta hi a, kum 80 ahi hi. Amah in Mahanaim ah kumpipa a om sungin a kisapnate a sik hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen a hau mahmah khat ahi hi.
Kumpipa in Barzillai kiangah, “Kei tawh Yerusalem ah hong galkah in, kei tawh na om sungteng nang kong sik ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Barzillai in kumpipa kiangah, “Kumpipa tawh Yerusalem ah kong pai nadingin ka nuntak kum bangzah nei nawn ka hi hiam?

Tu-in keimah kum 80 ka hi hi. A hoih leh a sia kilamdanna zong gen thei ka hi hiam? Na nasempa keimah in a nek a dawnte a limna zong thei nawn ahi hiam? Lasa numeite leh pasalte aw-te zong za thei nawn ahi hiam? Bang hangin kumpipa tungah na nasempa keimah in vangik hong behlap ding ka hi hiam?
Na nasempa in Yardan kalkhat ah tawmvei sung kumpipa kong zui ding hi; ahih hangin kumpipa in hi bangin hamphatna hong pia ding na hi hiam?

Na nasempa ciahkik ding hong phal in, tua hileh na nu leh ka pa’ hankhukte nai ka khuapi ah ka si thei ding hi. Ahih hangin hih lai-ah na nasempa Kimham om hi. Amah in kumpipa tawh hong galkah tahen. Ama aa dingin hoih nasak bangin na hihsak in,” a ci hi.
Kumpipa in, “Kimham in kei tawh hong galkah ding a, hoih nasak bangin ama aa dingin ka hih ding hi. Tu-in kei kiang nong cih peuhpeuh ka hih ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin mi khempeuh in Yardan kan uh a, tua khit ciangin kumpipa in kan hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in Barzillai namin, thupha pia a, ama inn ah a ciahkik hi.
Gilgal ah kumpipa galkahin, amah tawh Kimham a pai khawm hi. Yahdah galkap khempeuh in kumpipa kha uh a, Israyl galkap alang in zong a kha uh hi.

Tua ciangin Israyl mi khempeuh kumpipa kiangah pai-in, ama kiangah, “Bang hangin ka sanggamte uh ahi Yahdah mite in nang hong gukhia-in, nang leh na innkuante leh na mite khempeuh Yardan kantanin hong puak ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Yahdah mite khempeuh in Israyl mite dawng uh a, “Kumpipa pen ko tawh beh kinai ka hih manun hih bangin ka hih uh ahi hi. Tua hi-a bang hangin hih thu ah heh na hi uh hiam? Kote in kumpipa’ an neksak ka hi uh hiam? Amah in letsong khatpeuh kote hong pia ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Israyl mite in Yahdah mite dawngkikin, a gen inah, “Kumpipa sungah tanh sawm ka nei uh hi; tua ahih manin David sungah no tawh sangin ko tawh ka kisaizaw uh hi. Tua hi napi-in bang hangin hong simmawh bawl na hi uh hiam? Ka kumpipa uh lakkik ding a gen masa pen ko hilo ka hi uh hiam?” a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Israyl mite kammal sangin Yahdah mite dawnna khauhzaw hi.

Tua lai-ah Belial; a lehdo leh buaina a piangsak, mi khat hong om a, ama min pen Sheba hi a, Benyamin mi Bichri’ tapa ahi hi. Amah in peengkul tumin awng a, “David sungah eite aa dingin tanh omlo hi; Yishai’ tapa sungah i kihel kei ding hi! Israyl aw, na inn ciat uhah ciah un!” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin David a cing Israyl mi khempeuh in Bichri’ tapa Sheba zui dingin amah taisan hi. Ahih hangin Yardan panin Yerusalem dong lam tawntung ah Yahdah mite a kumpipa kiangah a om uh hi.

Yerusalem-a a inn ah David tung hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in inn kem dingin a nusiat a zineu numei sawmte la-in, inn cing dingin amaute koihin amaute huh a, ahih hangin amaute luppih nawn lo hi. Amaute meigongin om a, a sih ni dongun amaute kikhumcip hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Amasa kiangah, “Ni thum sungin kei aa dingin Yahdah mite hong kaikhopsak inla, nang mahmah zong hiah hong om in,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Yahdah mite khawmin a sam dingin Amasa a pai ciangin David in a sehsa hun sangin amah zekaizaw hi.

Kumpipa in Abishai kiangah, “Tu-in Absalom sangin Bichri’ tapa Sheba in eite hong nasakzaw ding hi. Amah in khuapi muanhuaite mu-in eite kiang panin a suahtak ma-in na ukpa’ mite sam inla, amah nungdelh in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Abishai’ thupuakna nuai ah Yerusalem panin Bichri’ tapa Sheba delh dingin Chereth mi khempeuh, Peleth mite leh galhat mi khempeuh tawh Yahab’ mite dingkhia uh hi.

Gibeon-a suangtum lianpi ah amaute a om laitakun, amaute tawh kimu dingin Amasa a pai hi. Yahab in a galkap puanpi silh a, a paai-a kisiat langnihhiam temta neu khat a kivawh kawnggak khat a kawngah a gak hi. A mailam a manawh laitakin a paai panin kidokkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Yahab in Amasa kiangah, “Ka sanggampa aw, nang tungah nopna om tahen,” a ci hi. Tua khit ciangin Yahab in amah a nam ding danin a taklam khut tawh a biangmul panin a len hi.

Ahih hangin Amasa in Yahab’ khut sungah temta neu a om lam awlmawh kha lo a, tua ciangin Yahab in a gilpi ah a dawt hi. Amasa’ gilzangte leilak ah luangkhia a, nihvei dawt kul lo hi. Hi bangin Amasa si hi. Tua ciangin Yahab leh a sanggampa Abishai in Bichri’ tapa Sheba delh suak lai uh hi.
Amasa kiangah Yahab’ mi khat ding a, “Yahab gumin, David aa dingin a om peuhmah in Yahab zui tahen!” a ci hi.

Lampi laizang a sisan lakah Amasa kidiahin om a, galkapte khempeuh Amasa hangin a khawl lam uh mipa in a mu hi. Tuapa in Amasa omna a tung peuhpeuh a khawlna a muh ciangin lampi panin lo lamah kaikhia-in, ama tungah puan khat tawh a khuh hi.
Lampi panin Amasa a kihepkhiat khit phetin Bichri’ tapa Sheba delh dingin Yahab nungah mite khempeuh a paisuak uh hi.
Sheba in Abel Beth Maacah dong Israyl minam sung khempeuh nawksuakin Ber mite khempeuh kaikhawmin a nung a zui uh hi.

Abel Beth Maacah ah Yahab leh a galkap honte tungin, amah umcih uh hi. Amaute in khuapi umcihin lei sungvumin, kulhpi pualam ah ding uh a, Yahab tawh galkap hon khempeuh in kulh phupai dingin a nawk damdam uh hi.
Tua ciangin numei pil khat in khuapi panin samin, “Na ngai un! Na ngai un! Yahab tawh ka kiho theih nadingin hih lai-ah hong pai nadingin tu-in na gen un,” a ci hi.

Ama kiang nai-ah Yahab a tun ciangin numeinu in, “Yahab na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Ka hi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Na nasemnu’ aw hong ngai in,” a ci hi. Amah in, “Ka ngai hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tuanu in, “Sawtpek lai-in amaute in, ‘A dawnna ngah nadingin Abel ah dong un,’ ci-in kigen ngei a, tua in thu a siangsak hi.

Kote pen Israyl sungah lungnuamtak leh citak takin ka om uh hi. Ahih hangin nang in Israyl sungah nu tawh a kibang khuapi khat suksiat ding na hanciam hi. Bang hangin Yahweh’ gamhluah khat valhtum ding na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Yahab in, “Tua bang ka hi peuhmah kei hi. Ka valhtum ding ahi a, ka suksiat ding ahi zongin Yahweh in hong kham hi!

A thu tua hilo hi. Ephraim mualtung gam panin mi khat ahi Bichri’ tapa a min Sheba kici pa in kumpipa David langpanin a khut liik hi. Hih mipa hong pia peuh le uh cin khuapi panin ka nungkik ding uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Numeinu in Yahab kiangah, “Na en in. Kulh tung panin nang kiangah a lutang hong kilawn ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua khit ciangin tua numeinu in ama ngaihsutna pilna tawh a mi khempeuh kiangah pai-in, amaute in Bichri’ tapa Sheba’ lutang tankhia-in, Yahab kiangah a lot uh hi. Tua khit ciangin Yahab in peengkul tumin, khuapi panin a nungkik uh hi. Mi khempeuh a inn ciat ah ciah uh a, Yerusalem-a kumpipa kiangah Yahab a ciah hi.
Tu-in Yahab in Israyl galkap buppi uk a, Yahyada’ tapa Benayah in Chereth mite leh Peleth mite uk hi;
Adoram in zawhthawhthu-a na kisemsakte uk a, Ahilud’ tapa Yahshaphat pen thu ciamtehpa ahi hi;
Sheva pen lai-at hi a, Zadok leh Abiathar-te pen siampite ahi uh hi;
Yair mi Ira zong David i siampi ahi hi.

David hun sungin kum thum sung kum khat khit kum khat kialpi om hi; tua ahih manin David in Yahweh kiangah thu dong hi. Yahweh in dawngin, “Shaul in Gibeon mite that ahih manin Shaul leh a innkuan tungah a sisan luansakna hang ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin kumpipa in Gibeon mite samin amaute a hopih hi. (Tu-in hih Gibeon mite pen Israyl mite lak pan hi lo a, Amor mite laka a suaktasunte ahi uh hi. Israyl mite in amaute hingkhawi ding kiciam khin uh a, ahih hangin Shaul in Israyl mite leh Yahdah mite a deihsakluatna hangin amaute suksiat siang ding a hanciam hi.)
David in Gibeon mite kiangah, “Note aa dingin bang hong hihsak ding ka hi hiam? Yahweh’ gamhluahna thupha na piak theih nadingin bangci bangin hong puahkik ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Gibeon mite in ama kiangah, “Shaul kiang pan ahi a, a innkuanpih pan ahi zongin ngun ahi a, kham ahi zongin hong pia kei inla, kote hangin Israyl mi khatpeuh zong that kei in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin David in, “Note aa ding kong hihsak dingin nong nget uh bang ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in kumpipa dawngin, “Kote hong susia-in, kote langah sawmsim a, Israyl sungah mun ka neih loh nadingun kote thatbeipa—

Ama suan pasal sagih kote tungah hong kipia henla, Yahweh teelsa Shaul i Gibeah-a Yahweh mai-ah amaute ka khailum ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in, “Amaute kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh mai-ah David leh Shaul’ tapa Yahnathan kikala ama kiciamna hangin kumpipa in Shaul’ tupa, Yahnathan tapa Mephibosheth hawi hi;
Ahih hangin Aiah tanu Rizpah in Shaul tawh a neih tapa nihte ahi Armoni leh Mephibosheth; Shaul’ tanu Merab in Meholath mi Barzillai’ tapa Adriel tawh a neih a tapa ngate, kumpipa in la hi.

David in Gibeon mite khut sungah amaute pia a, amaute in Yahweh mai mual tungah amaute a khailum hi. Amaute a sagih-un si khawm uh hi. Mangbuh-ham lak kipat hun, anlak kipat hun sungin amaute kithat hi.

Aiah’ tanu Rizpah in puanhampi la-in, suang tung khat ah a phah hi. Amah in anlak kipat huna kipan vantung panin amaute tungah guah a kibuaksuk kipat dong amah in sunin huih lak vasate in ahi a, zanin gamlak gamsate in ahi zongin misi luangte a sukhasak kei hi.
Aiah’ tanu, Shaul’ zineu gamtatna thu David kiangah a kikoh ciangin,

David pai-in Yabesh Gilead panin Shaul leh a tapa Yahnathan guhte a la hi. (Philistia-te in Gilboa ah Shaul a sattuk khit uh ciangin Philistia-te in amaute a khailupna mun Beth Shan tual panin simtham takin amaute a kila sim ahi hi.)
Tua lai panin David in Shaul leh a tapa Yahnathan guhte pua a, a kikhai laite uh zong a khawm hi.

Amaute in Benyamin gam Zela-a a pa uh Kish han ah Shaul leh Yahnathan-te guhte a phum uh hi. Amaute in kumpipa thupiak khempeuh a hih uh hi. Tua khit ah Yahweh in gam sung aa dinga thu a kingetnate a dawng hi.
Khat vei leuleu Philistia-te leh Israyl-te kikalah galkidona om hi. David leh amah tawh a om a mite kuansukin, Philistia-te tawh kido uh a, David a gim mahmah hi.
Rapha’ suante khat, teipi sumngo shekel zathum a gik namsau thak khat a kuah Ishbi-Benob in David thah dingin ngaihsun hi.

Ahih hangin Zeruyah’ tapa Abishai a hon dingin hong pai a, Philistiapa vatin a that hi. Tua ciangin David’ mite ama tungah kiciamin, “Israyl-te meivak na mitsak loh nadingin gal sungah kote tawh cikmahin nong kuan nawn peuhmah kei ding hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tu-a khit ciangin Gob ah Philistia-te tawh kidona khat om leuleu hi. Hushath mi Sibbechai in Rapha’ suante khat ahi Saph a that hi.

Gob-a Philistia-te tawh kidona dang khat ah Bethlehem panin Yair Oregim’ (Siamganpa Yair’) tapa Elhanan in siamganpa’ siam lawngpi tawh a kibang teipi gol a nei Git mi Goliath’ sanggampa Lahmi a that hi.
Gath-a galkidona dang khat ah, a khut lang tuak ah khutme guk, kheme guk: a vekin sawmnih le li a nei, mi gol mahmah khat om hi. Amah zong Rapha suanlekhakte pan mah ahi hi.
Amah in Israyl phinin a ko ciangin, David’ sanggampa Shammah’ tapa Yahnathan in a that hi.
Hih mi lite pen Gath-a Rapha’ suanlekhakte hi a, David leh a mite khutin amaute puk uh hi.
David in a galte khempeuh kiang pan leh Shaul vangliatna panin Yahweh a hotkhiat ni-in hih lamalte Yahweh tungah gen hi.
Amah in, “Yahweh pen ka Suangpi, ka kulhpi leh ka honpa ahi hi.

Yahweh pen ka Suangpi hi a, Ama sungah ka lungmuang ding hi. Amah pen ka Kidalna leh ka hotkhiatna Ki; thahatna, ka Munkip leh ka Bukna, ka Honpa ahi hi; Nangmah in mi ngongtatte kiang panin nong honkhia hi.
Phat dingin a kilawm Yahweh ka sam a, ka galte kiang panin kei hong kihonkhia hi.
Sihna tuihual in kei hong tuum a, Belial’ tuikhang; suksiatna, in kei hong lausak hi.
Sheol; hankhuk, khauhualte in kei hong vial a, sihna thangzakte in kei hong maingat uh hi.
Ka lungkham ciangin Yahweh ka sam a, ka Pa kiangah ka kiko hi. Amah in a biakinn siangtho panin ka aw hong za a, Ama bil ah ka kahna tung hi.
Tua ciangin leitung liingin kising a, vantungte bulpite kilok hi; Amah heh a hih manin amaute liing uh hi.
A nakvangte panin meikhu suakkhia a, a kamsung panin a netum meikuang paikhia-in mei-am a lengkhia hi.
Amah in vantungte nusia-in, hong tuaksuk a, ama khe tungah meii sah mahmah a om hi.
Amah cherub khat tungah tuangin leng a, huih khate tungah a kilang hi.
Amah in ama kiimkot ah kikhuhna khuamialpi bawl a, vanpi meiite panin a khal guah bangin a zu hi.
Ama omna khuavakphatna panin kektang a kuang khia hi.
Amah in vantungte panin vangingsak a, Sangpenpa Yahweh’ awging kithawn hi.
Amah in thaltangte kapkhia a, amaute kithehthang hi; kektangte tawh Amah in amaute taikeksak hi.
Yahweh in tai-in, a nakvangte panin a hu hong nunkhiat ciangin tuipi’ luanna zawite kimu-in leitung bulpite a kidawk hi.
A tunglam panin amah in sawl a, Amah in kei hong lenin, tui thukpi panin kei hong kaikhia hi.
A vanglian ka gal leh kei hong mudah ka langte kiang panin amah in kei hong honkhia hi; kei aa dingin amaute thahat lua uh hi.
Amaute in ka tuahsiatni-in kei hong simgawp uh a, ahih hangin Yahweh pen kei hong huhpa ahi hi.
Amah in mun tanzau khat ah kei hong paikhiatpih a, kei tungah lungkim ahih manin amah in kei hong honkhia hi.
Yahweh in ka thumaanna tawh kizui-in sehtanh hong pia hi. Ka khutte sianthona tawh kizui-in thaman hong pia hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ lampite ka zui a, ka Pa kiang panin pialin gitlohna ka gamta ngei kei hi.
A taktakin Ama thukhennate khempeuh ka mai-ah om a, Ama ngeina kipte panin ka kihemkhia ngei kei hi.
Ama mai-ah kawkbaang loin ka om a, mawhna panin ka kikem hi.
Yahweh in ka thumaanna tawh kizui leh ama mit ah ka khutte sianthona tawh kizui-in thaman hong pia hi.
A muanhuaite tungah na muanhuaina na kilak a, a kawkbaang lote tungah na kawkbaang lohna na kilak hi;
A siangtho mi tungah na sianthona na lak hi; ahih hangin a thukawi mi tungah a lungkawi-in na kilak hi.
Nangmah in a kiniamkhiat mi na hon ding a, ahih hangin a kiphasak mite na niamkhiat theih nadingin na en gige hi.
Yahweh aw, nang pen ka meivak na hi hi! Yahweh in ka mialna hong taan ding hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh nang hangin galkap honte kiang panin ka taikhia zo a, ka Pa hangin kulhpi ka kan zo hi.
Yahweh, a lampi kicing a; Yahweh’ Thukham in siatna nei lo hi. Amah pen ama sungah bu-in amah a muang mi khempeuh aa dingin kidalna lum ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh longal Pa kua hiam? I Pa longal Suangpi kua ahi hiam?
Hih in ka belh muanhuai Yahweh hi a, amah in ka lampi hong hoihkimsak hi.
Amah in sazukte khe bangin ka khe hong kipsak a, munsangnate ah kei hong dingsak hi.
Amah in ka khutte galsim theih nadingin hong sinsak a, tua ahih manin sumngo thalte ka kekzo hi.
Nangmah in na hotkhiatna lum zong kei nong pia a, na nunnemna in kei hong liansak hi.
Ka khete a pial loh nadingin keima nuai-ah lampi na tanzaisak hi.
Keimah in ka galte delhin amaute ka susia hi; a kisiat matengun ka kilehkik kei hi.
Keimah in amaute susia-in ka gawi hi; tua ahih manin amaute thozo nawn kei uh hi; amaute ka khe nuai-ah puk uh hi.
Galsim dingin thahatna nong guan a, kei langah a ding mite ka nuai-ah na nengniam hi.
Nangmah in ka galte ngawnte nong pia hi; tua ahih manin kei hong mudahte ka susia hi.
Amaute huhna genin kiko uh a, ahih hangin amaute a huh ding kuamah omlo hi. Amaute Yahweh tungah kiko uh a, ahih hangin Amah in dawng lo hi.
Leitunga leivui bangin amaute ka satnen a, kongzinga buannawi bangin sikzanin ka tuancil hi.
Ka mite hong simna panin nong hukhia hi; Nangmah in Gentile-te lutangin kei nong kem hi. Ka theih loh mite in keima na sem ding uh hi.
Gamdang mite in ka thu a zak phetun kei khut nuai-ah hong ki-ap uh a, ka thu hong mang uh hi.
Gamdang mite’ tapate lungkia uh a, amau phualkip panin amau le amau galvan tawh a kithawi uh hi.
Yahweh nungta hi! Ka Suangpi kiphat tahen! Ka hotkhiatna Suangpi ahi Yahweh kitawisang hen!
Amah ka phu hong laksakpa Yahweh hi a, keima nuai-ah mite a nuaisiahpa hi a,
ka galte kiang panin hong honpa ahi hi. Nangmah in kei hong langpangte tungah nong domto hi; a ngongtat mite kiang panin kei hong hukhia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh aw, Gentile mite lakah nang kong phat ding a, Nangma Min phatna late ka sa ding hi!
Amah pen a kumpipa aa dingin hotkhiatna tausangpi hi a, Ama sathau nilhsa David tung leh a suanlekhakte tungah a tawntungin migitna a lak hi.
Hihte pen Yishai’ tapa, a kitawisang mipa, Yaaqob’ Pa i sathau nilhpa, Israyl sunga psalm late a sapa’ kammal nunungte ahi hi:
“Yahweh’ Kha in kei tungtawnin thu gen a, ka leii tungah ama kammal om hi.
Israyl’ Pa in thugen a, Israyl Suangpi in kei tungah thu hong genin, ‘Mite a ukpa in thumaanna tawh uk pelmawh ding a, Yahweh zahtakna tawh uk ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah pen meii kai loh ni zingsang zing nisuaktung khuavak tawh kibang ding a, leitung panin lopa a pokhiasak guah a zukkhit cianga khuavak silsel tawh kibang ding hi,’ a ci hi.

Hi hi, ka innkuan zong Yahweh tawh kizopna man hilo ahi hiam? A taktakin amah in kei tawh tawntung thuciamna bawl a, na khenkhenin gualin a kipsak hi. Ka hotkhiatna khempeuh leh ka deih peuhpeuh Amah in tangtungsak taktak ding hilo ahi hiam?
Ahih hangin Belial tapate; a lehdo leh migilote, khempeuh ahih leh khut tawh a kikhawm paihkhiat dinga kihemkhia lingte tawh kibang hi.
Amaute a lawng peuhmah in sik pumtawn khat ahi a, tuipi ahi zongin zang uh hi; tua ciangin amaute pukna ah amaute mei tawh haltum ding ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Hihte pen David’ mi thahatte ahi hi: Hachmon mi Yashobam (Yosheb Basshebeth; tutphah-a a tu pa a cihna ahi hi.) pen galkap bute a ukpa ahi hi. Amah in hun khat sungin mi 800 that ahih manin amah pen Ezni mi Adino kici hi.

Ama zom ah Ahoh mi Dodai’ tapa Eleazar ahi hi. Mi thahat thumte lakah khat ahih na tawh kizui-in, galkido dingin Pas Dammim ah a kikaikhawm Philistia-te phinin, Israyl mite a nungkik lai-un David tawh om khawm hi.

Ahih hangin amah dingkipin, a khut a kham dong namsau leh a khut a kimatcip dongin Philistia-te a that hi. Tua ni-in Yahweh in gualzawhna lianpi tungsak a, ahih hangin misite’ van a khawm ding bekin galkap honte a ciahkik hi.

Eleazar khit ciangin Harar mi Agee’ tapa Shammah ahi hi. Besan a dimin a omna mun lo khat ah galsim dingin Philistia-te kikaikhawm uh hi. Tua lai-ah Philistia-te kiang panin Israyl galkap honte a taimang uh hi.
Ahih hangin Shammah in lo lai panin panmun la-in Philistia-te do-in a that hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in gualzawhna lianpi a pia hi.
Rephaim Kuam ah Philistia galkap hon khat in giahphual a sat laitakun Adullam kuahawma David kiangah anlak hunin ukpi sawmthum lak panin thum hong pai uh hi.
Tua hunin mun muanhuai ah David om a, Bethlehem ah Philistia khuacingte om uh hi.
Tua ciangin David lunggulhna tawh, “Aw, Bethlehem kongpi gei-a tuikhuk panin dawn ding tui khatpeuh in hong pia leh ut sing maw!” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin mi thahat thumte in Philistia-te galpanna phuletin Bethlehem kongpi kianga tuikhuk panin tui khai-in, David kiangah a puak uh hi. Ahih hangin amah in dawn nuam lo hi. A dawn tangin amah in Yahweh kiangah tua tui a sung hi.

Amah in, “Yahweh aw, hih tui ka dawn peuhmah kei ding hi! Hih pen amau’ nuntakna khamin a pai mite’ sisan hilo ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin David in tua tui dawn nuam lo hi. Hih mi thahat thumte hanzia tu-a bang ahi hi.
Zeruyah’ tapa Yahab’ sanggampa Abishai pen adang thumte ukpa ahi hi. Amah in a teipi tawh mi zathum do-in amaute that a, hih mi thumte lakah min a ngah hi.
Mi thumte lakah a kipahtawi pen hilo ahi hiam? Tua ahih manin a masa thumte lakah a kihel loh hangin hih thumte ukpa a suak hi.

Kabzeel panin Yahyada’ tapa Benayah pen galdo siam galhang mi hi a, na lianpi tampi a sem hi. Amah in Moab-te galsiampen nih that hi. Amah paisuk lai-in vukkiat ni khatin leihawm laizanga om humpinelkai khat a that hi.

Amah in Egypt mi a gol mahmah khat a that hi. Tua Egypt mipa in a khut sungah teipi khat tawi a, ahih hangin ama kiangah khetbuk khat tawi-in Benayah a paisuk hi. Amah in Egypt mipa khut sung panin a teipi bawhkhiatsakin, ama teipi mah tawh a that hi.
Yahyada’ tapa in hih na liante hihin a thahat mi thumte lakah min a ngah hi.
Amah pen sawmthumte sangin kipahtawizaw a, ahih hangin a masa thumte a banzo kei hi. Tua ciangin David in ama pumpi a cing dingin amah a koih hi.
Yahab’ sanggampa Asahel pen sawmthumte lakah a kihel khat hi a, Bethlehem panin Dodo’ tapa Elhanan,
Harod mi Shammah, Harod mi Elika,
Palti mi Helez, Tekoa panin Ikkesh’ tapa Ira,
Anathoth panin Abiezer, Hushath mi Mebunnai,
Ahoh mi Zalmon, Netophath mi Maharai,
Netophath mi Baanah’ tapa Heleb, Benyamin-a Gibeah panin Ribai’ tapa Ithai,
Pirathon mi Benayah, Gaash luite pan Hiddai,
Arbath mi Abi Albon, Barhum mi Azmaveth,
Shaalbon mi Eliahba (Yashen’ tapate pan), Yahnathan,
Harar mi Shammah, Harar mi Sharar’ tapa Ahiam,
Maacath mi Ahasbai’ tapa Eliphelet, Gilon mi Ahithophel’ tapa Eliam,
Carmel mi Hezro, Arb mi Paarai,
Zobah panin Nathan’ tapa Igal, Haggadi’ tapa,
Ammon mi Zelek, Beeroth mi Naharai, Zeruyah’ tapa Yahab’ galhiam puapa,
Ithri mi Ira, Ithri mi Gareb,
Hit mi Uriyah ahi uh hi. A vekin sawmthum le sagih ahi hi.

headings.text: David in Galsimthei Mi Phazah Sim

verses.text: Israyl-te in David tungah, “Pai unla, Israyl-te leh Yahdah-te a phazah sim in,” a cih nadingin Satan in amaute hanthawn ahih manin Israyl-te tungah Yahweh heh leuleu hi.

Tua ahih manin kumpipa in amah tawh a om galkap mangpa Yahab thupia-in, “Dan panin Beersheba dong Israyl minam sung khempeuh ah pai inla galsim thei mi phazah va sim in, tua hileh bangzah om hiam cih teltakin ka thei ding hi,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Yahab in kumpipa kiangah, “Yahweh na pa in galkapte a zah zakhat valin khangsak henla, kumpipa’ mit in mu tahen. Ahih hangin ka uk kumpipa in hih bang na hih ding bang hangin lunggulh na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Ahi zongin kumpipa’ kammal in Yahab leh galkap ukte zo hi. Tua ahih manin Israyl galdo thei mi sim dingin kumpipa omna panin Yahab leh galkap ukte a paikhia uh hi.
Yardan a kan khit uh ciangin amaute in guampi sunga om khuapi’ leitaw lama om Aroer nai-ah giahphual sat uh a, tua khit ciangin Gad nawkin Yazer ah pai uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Gilead leh Tahtim Hodshi kuam ah pai uh a, tua ciangin Dan Yaan ah pai-in Sidon kiim ah pai uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Tyre mun muanhuai lamah pai-in, Hiv mite leh Canaan mite khuapite khempeuh ah tung uh hi. A tawpna ah Yahdah gam Negev sunga Beersheba ah amaute tung uh hi.
Amaute gam sung khempeuh pai-in kha kua leh ni sawmnih a bei khit ciangin Yerusalem ah tungkik uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahab in kumpipa kiangah galsim thei mi khempeuh a phazah genkhia hi. Israyl sungah namsau a tawi galhang mi tul zagiat (800,000) om a, Yahdah sungah tul zanga (500,000) om hi.

David in galsim thei mi a sim khit ciangin ama lungsim in amah gimsak mahmah ahih manin amah in Yahweh kiangah, “Ka gamtatnasa sungah nakpi takin ka mawhkhin hi. Tu-in Yahweh aw, na nasempa mawhna hong paihkhiatsak in; bang hang hiam cihleh ka haihuai mahmahin ka gamta hi,” ci-in a kipulaak hi.
Zingsang David a thawh hunin David’ thumu theipa kamsang Gad tungah Yahweh kammal hong tungin a gen inah:
“Pai inla David kiangah gen in, ‘Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Nangma tungah teel ding nam thum kong pia a, nang tungah kong tunsak dingin nang mahmah in tuate khat teel in,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin David kiangah Gad pai-in ama kiangah, “Na gam sungah kum sagih sung kialpi hong tung ding kilawmzaw hiam? Na galte in nang hong delh sungin na galte kiang panin kha thum sung taitai huaizaw ding hiam? Ahih keileh na gam sungah ni thum pulpi om huaizaw ding ahi hiam? Tu-in ngaihsun inla, kei hong sawlpa ka dawnkik theih nadingin khensat in,” a ci hi.
David in Gad kiangah, “Ka lungkham lua mahmah hi. Yahweh’ hehpihna lianlua mahmah ahih manin Ama khut sungah hong puksak inla, ahih hangin mihingte khut sungah hong puksak kei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Israyl-te tungah zingsang panin a kisehsa hun dong Yahweh in pulnatna tungsak hi. Dan panin Beersheba dong mi 70,000 si hi.

Vantungmi in Yerusalem susia dingin a khut a zankhiat ciangin Yahweh suksiatna panin a lungsim khiamin mite a susia vantungmi kiangah, “Phazo hi! Na khut dokkik in!” a ci hi. Tua laitakin Yebus mite Araunah’ ancilna ah Yahweh’ vantungmi a om hi.

Mite a susia vantungmi David in a muh ciangin amah in Yahweh kiangah, “Hih gitlohna gamta-in a mawh keimah ka hi taktak hi. Ahih hangin hih tuute, bang gamta uh ahi hiam? Kong thuum hi, keima tung leh ka pa’ innkuan tungah na khut tawh hong su in,” a ci hi.
Tua ni-in David kiangah Gad pai-in, ama kiangah, “Paito inla, Yebus mite Araunah’ ancilna ah Yahweh aa dingin biaknatau khat lam in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Gad tungtawnin Yahweh in thu a piaksa bangin David a paito hi.
Araunah khuadakin kumpipa leh a mite ama kiang lamah a paina a muh ciangin, amah pusuak a, a maitang leilam ngatin kumpipa mai-ah a kunsuk hi.

Tua khit ciangin Araunah in, “Bang hangin na nasempa kiangah ka uk kumpipa hong pai na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. David in, “Mite tunga pulnatna a veng theih nadingin Yahweh tungah biaknatau ka lam nadingin na ancilna mun hong lei ding ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Araunah in David kiangah, “Ka uk kumpipa in la inla, hoih nasak bangbangin pia in. Meihal biakna dingin hih lai-ah ka bawngtalte om a, sing dingin ancilna peekpite leh bawng kolte hih lai-ah om hi.
Kumpipa aw, hihte khempeuh Araunah in kumpipa kiangah kong pia hi,” a ci hi. Tua khit ciangin Araunah in kumpipa kiangah, “Yahweh na Pa in nang hong sang tahen!” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in Araunah kiangah, “Hilo hi, nangma tung panin hihte a man tawh kituakin kong lei ding hi; tua hikei leh kei sum bei loin Yahweh ka Pa tungah meihal biaknate ka pia kei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in ngun shekel sawmnga tawh ancilna phual leh bawngtalte lei hi.

Tua lai-ah David in Yahweh aa dingin biaknatau khat lam a, meihal biaknate leh kilemna biaknate a pia hi. Tua ahih manin Yahweh in gam aa dingin thu kingetnate ngai a, Israyl-te tunga pulnatna a veng hi.
